title: Jumla Rara Lake Trek
summary: Jumla Rara Lake Trek lies towards the western part of Nepal. The highest point of altitude of this trek is 3060m. The route is mostly downhill.

seo.title: Jumla Rara Lake Trek | Route Map, Cost and Guide
seo.description: Jumla Rara Lake Trek lies towards the western part of Nepal. The highest point of altitude of this trek is 3060m. The route is mostly downhill.

overview:
Jumla Rara Lake Trek lies towards the western part of the country and it is protected by Rara National Park, the smallest national park of Nepal, covering area of 106 sq km. This Jumla- Rara Lake trekking through this remote wilderness of western Nepal offers a superb experience of nature and a visit to Rara Lake, Nepal’s Largest Lake at 3,062 m

Beginning the trek from the mountain airstrip of Jumla after flying from Kathmandu via Nepalgunj, the trail passes through green countryside which provides unusual glimpses of a culture and scenery quite different from that found elsewhere in Nepal and which eventually culminates to the Rara Lake National Park.

This beautiful high altitude lake is surrounded by alpine meadows and forests of pine, juniper and spruce, whilst in the background you can view the magnificent snow-capped peaks of the Himalayas. The entire route is ‘off the beaten track’ which involves the crossing of Ghurchi Lagna pass at 3,450 m on the way to Rara Lake and a few ridges at around 3,000 m when hiking on the way back.

itinerary.title: Fly from Kathmandu to Nepalgunj (150m / 492ft) takes around 40 minutes.
itinerary.html: Today we take an hour-long flight from Kathmandu to Nepalgunj, located in Western Nepal. This flight offers you enchanting aerial views of the jungles and Himalayan Range. Nepalgunj is one of the Terai big towns. After check in hotel in Nepalgunj we visit the local market. Stay overnight at lodge.

itinerary.title: Fly from Nepalgunj to Jumla (2,370m / 7,776ft), takes around 35 minutes.
itinerary.html: After early breakfast we fly to the hilly landscape of Jumla. You are in a complete different landscape as you have landed an a very remote area of Far- eastern region of Nepal. Enjoy the view of Sisne Himal, Dudu Kundari Himal and other unnamed mountains .

itinerary.title: Trek from Jumla to Patmara (2,920m / 9,580ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: The early part of the trail is flat and after some distance begins a steep ascent to Patmara. En route you pass pine forests, green hills and through picturesque villages. Patmara is a relatively big village with chortens, prayer flags, Mani walls and temples dedicated to Hindi God and Goddess. People living here follow either the Buddhist or Hindu religion.

itinerary.title: Trek from Patmara to Bhargaon (2,690m / 8,825ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: You trek along a steeply ascending path for early two hours. After you cross Kharila pass (3,050 m), the trails go down gently until you reach Nyawer (2,670 m) village. Bhargaon is relatively a big village where there are monasteries, chorten, and prayer flags fluttering in the breeze.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bhargaon to Pina (380m / 1,247ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: The trails you move through gently ascend until you cross a suspension bridge. Again you trek along an ascending path until reaching the check point of Rara National Park at Bhulbule (3,130 m). Here you have to pay an entrance fee in order to get inside the National Park. The trail to Ghurchi La Pass (3,460 m) is a steep ascent before turning steeply downhill all the way to Pina.

itinerary.title: Trek from Pina to Gumgarhi (2,580m / 8,465ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: This day you cross a wooden bridge over Jhari Khola (stream) and follow a mostly ascending path. At some places the trail goes downhill. On the way, you can observe musk deer and pheasant in forests covered with pine, juniper, oak, rhododendron and other natural vegetation. Gumgarhi is yet another village mostly inhabited by Sherpa, Gurung and other castes.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gumgarhi to Rara Lake (3,060m / 10,039ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: The route is mostly downhill but goes uphill for some distance. You come across villages and forests. This day you can enjoy the sight of the magnificent lake which is Rara. Naturally built, Rara Lake is the biggest lake of Nepal.

itinerary.title: Rest at Rara Lake (3,060m / 10,039ft).
itinerary.html: On this day you can walk around the lake to see the wild animals, birds and beauty of nature.

itinerary.title: Trek from Rara Lake to Jhari (2,500m / 8,202ft), takes around 7 hours.
itinerary.html: To reach Jhari, you trek on a steeply descending path following forests and a wooden bridge over the Jhari Khola and villages. Jhari is a small village where mainly inhabited by Gurung who are close to life style of Tibetan people.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jhari to Bhargaon (2,690m / 8,825ft.) 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: The route in the beginning moves downward and after some distance turns up until you cross Ghurchi La Pass (3,460 m). From here the route travels up and down for a while before descending to Bhargaon.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bhargaon to Patmara (2,920m / 9,580ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Leaving Bhargaon, you follow a steeply descending path all the way to Khari La Pass and then the route turns steeply down to Cherry (2,009 m). The route then moves through gentle flat land all the way to Patmara.

itinerary.title: Trek from Patmara to Jumla (2,370m / 7,776ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: This day you trek through a steeply descending path all the way to Jumla passing splendid views of green hill, forests, villages and ridges.

seo.description: 25 Days Kailash Tour and Simikot Trek recently opened destination. It is a special package designed for visitors and trekkers by Base Camp Adventure Team.

overview:
Kailash Tour and Simikot Trek is a special package designed for visitors and trekkers by Base Camp Adventure Team.This recently opened Simikot – Hilsa route to mystic Tibet (Western Tibet), endows you with the best of both Nepal and Tibet. Trekking from Nepal’s westernmost airstrip town Simikot to Tibet was open only in 1993. However pilgrims from Nepal have been frequently crossing over Tibet via Simikot – Hilsa route from the time immemorial.
Access to Tibet from Simikot is the shortest and the most practical for travelers in every aspect from acclimatization to cultural endowment.

Unless customized, Simikot Trek normally commences from Simikot (2,910 m) itself. As there is no direct flight from Kathmandu, transition would be in Nepaljung Airport. Then the trail winds through the picturesque valley of Humla Karnali. Humla is Nepal’s highest, northernmost and most remote region which is culturally and scenically very rewarding to trek through. The people of the Northern Humla are Bhotia people whose roots are in Tibet and they still enjoy the privilege to graze their animal in the Tibetan plateau. As the trek prolongs, it unravels pristine culture, landscape and flora and fauna. This six days trek eventually ends in Hilsa after traversing Na Lagna (4,330 m).

Simikot Trek beside its cultural affluence and natural beauty would provide quite an opportunity to well acclimatize before you arrive to an arid Tibetan Plateau. A detour from Limi Valley could be more exciting and adventurious.

Further Kailash Tour and Simikot Trek tour could be customized to Guge Kingdom (Toling and Tsaparang), Kailash Mansarovar or to Everest Base Camp eventually flying out from Lhasa or driving to Kathmandu.

seo.title: Kali Gandaki River Rafting | Rafting in Kali Gandaki
seo.description: Kali Gandaki River Rafting has 60 rapids over 60 kilometersis named after the goddess of destruction, Kali. It has bumpy, fast, and medium level rapids.

overview:
With 60 rapids over 60 kilometers the Kali Gandaki River Rafting is a thrill a minute! Named after the goddess of destruction, Kali, that’s why it is Nepal’s most holy river. Rising in the mystical region of Mustang, it drops off the roof of the world only to carve out the world’s deepest river gorge. As you roar through turbulent rapids, dodging huge boulders and sliding down glistening chutes into churning, frothy whirlpools, your adventure is set against the backdrop of the Annapurna range, its snowcapped peaks suspended in view through 120 kilometers of wilderness area and shadowy canyons of stone.

As you pass isolated villages precariously clinging to terraces high above the river, you will hear the melodic greeting of “Namaste” from the children. Locals and pilgrims alike worship Kali’s holy river, and at every confluence one can see the fire rings from many cremations. We will also float past the Shiva temple at Rubra Beni.

On the last day we meet the largest rapids, providing a thrilling climax to the journey of a lifetime! Kali Gandaki River Rafting has no warm up days on this river, you are straight into the action with bumpy, fast, and medium level rapids challenging you at every turn. Both experienced and first time rafters will enjoy the exciting rapids of the Kali Gandaki. At high water the Kali Gandaki is a Grade 4 river.

seo.title: Kanchenjunga Base Camp Trek | Cost | Itnerary | Base Camp Adventure
seo.description: Kanchenjunga Base Camp Trek is a long trek. Trek to Kanchenjunga is packed with complete adventure in every trials and trekking destination.

overview:
Trekking in the Kanchenjunga region situated in the far eastern side of Nepal is an adventurous journey made for daring people who are equally curious lovers of nature and diverse culture. Nepal opened trekking in Kanchenjunga region in 1988, although people have trekked in this region during mountaineering expeditions since the turn of the century. Kanchenjunga (8,586 m) is the third highest mountain in the world and is called the queen of the great Himalayas situated on the Nepal-Sikkim border high above beautiful dense forests with rivers flowing amid them.

The meaning of Kanchenjunga is Five Treasures of the Great Snow which refer to the five summits that make Kanchenjunga. The region Kanchenjunga is far away from Kathmandu and is reached by a full day bus ride via picturesque landscapes. During the Kanchenjunga Trek, you will observe the culture and lifestyle of Rai and Limbu communities as you reach many of their traditional villages. This region is full of rocky outcrops, low river valley, alpine grasslands, and sub-tropical and dense temperate forests. You will trek through Kanchenjunga Conservation Area with a possibility to spot rare wildlife like Himalayan black bear, musk deer, snow leopard, red panda, and the exceptional birds like red-billed blue magpie and pheasant. You will see many beautiful prayer walls, monasteries, temples, and Chortens along your way to Kanchenjunga Base Camp. A close-up view of Mount Kanchenjunga (8,586 m) and several other snow-clad peaks in the Nepal-Tibet and Nepal-India border along with a visit to the glaciers and the crossing of many passes are the highlights of Kanchenjunga Trek. Mount Kanchenjunga (8,586 m) is among the world’s most stunning mountains and offers varied ecological zones from subtropical land to glacial wildness, making it just the right trek for adrenaline seekers.

If you are a true adventurer, come and be a part of this wonderful journey with Base Camp Adventure. Our company has a decade-long experience in the travel and tourism industry and Nepal and is recognized as a leading trekking organization. We are committed to providing the best hospitality and care for the travelers who choose to travel with us.

itinerary.title: Day 01
itinerary.html: We travel to the far west and arrive in Surkhet very late/early hours of the next morning; You are able to have a sleep here.

itinerary.title: Day 02
itinerary.html: After breakfast, we will take a truck as far as the road goes until about lunch time [this all depends on availability be flexible]. After lunch we walk all afternoon to the put-in point at Sauli.

itinerary.title: Day 03
itinerary.html: After having heavy breakfast at 8:00 a.m. we get ready for wild ride. This section of the River is terribly wild. The continue rapid makes rafter forget to breathe. Lunch will be served en-route and camping at 03:00 p.m.

itinerary.title: Day 04
itinerary.html: This is the type of day that people imagine when they think of Himalayan water. It is big and continuous. We enter into the Jungle Corridor. This is a narrowing jungle clad gorge and it is all ours.

itinerary.title: Day 05
itinerary.html: More of the same including the notorious GOD’S house rapid. Camp at the Seti Dovan and relax.

itinerary.title: Day 06
itinerary.html: It isn’t over yet! Keep paddling hard! You really are experiencing the best of the west on yet another day of great action and breathe taking scenery and camping at Jamuna village

itinerary.title: Day 07
itinerary.html: This is a holiday after all so we have programmed a rest day so you can take time to enjoy your surroundings and relax on a great sandy beach.

itinerary.title: Day 08-09

itinerary.html: This is the final day of river. We end this trip in the early afternoon at Chisopani Bridge & lunch is served there. You will catch night bus at about 1530hrs to get back to Kathmandu or you can enjoy in Bardia National Park, which is famous for bird watching

overview:
Kathmandu Valley, the capital city of Nepal, is the valley surrounded by green hills, terraced fields and lofty snow-capped peaks in the background. This beautiful city is also called an open museum of medieval arts and architecture since it has numbers of Hindu temples, Buddhist stupas and monuments all around. Kathmandu City Tour takes you to all these sites carrying great historic and cultural importance and helps you understand all the ancient tradition and culture that has been followed since hundreds of year.

Our well designed Kathmandu City Tour package takes you to the lively and colorful places of Kathmandu where culture, religion, and tradition are the parts of everyday life. This extremely popular tour starts off with a bundle of tourist attraction sites of Kathmandu valley covers seven world heritages sites out of 10 heritage sites of Nepal listed by United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). During the visit, you will be visiting various such sites like Swayambhunath, Pashupatinath, Boudhanath, Kathmandu Durbar Square, Bhaktapur Durbar Square, Changunarayan and Patan Durbar Square. Besides these, you will also visit other important cultural and religious sites in the valley including Bungmati, Khokana and much more.

Kathmandu Durbar Square: Built in the 12th century, this old royal palace provides you numerous temples, the house of living goddess (kumari), Kasthamandap (House of Wood) and the oldest museum of Nepal.

Pashupatinath: It is the holiest Hindu pilgrimage destination in Nepal. It is believed that the temple dedicated to Shiva existed at the site in AD 879. However, the present temple was built by King Bhupatindra Malla in 1697. A gold-plated roof, silver door and woodcarvings are the major attractions in the temple.

Swayambhunath: This stupa is one of the holiest Buddhist sites in Nepal which is said to be almost two thousand years old. The four sides of the stupa are printed with the eyes of Lord Buddha so, it is also known as the watchful eyes of Buddha. Watching over Kathmandu valley from the temple is in itself a divine experience one can ever have.

Patan architectural city: Patan Durbar Square is a marvel of Newari Architecture. The major attractions of this city are numerous temples and idols dating back hundreds of years. Krishna mandir, Bhimsen Temple, Vishwanath Temple, Taleju Bhawani Temple are few of the many temples located in this city.

Bhaktapur city: Protected as a UNESCO world heritage site, Bhaktapur is the third major town of the valley. The city is one of the most charming architecture showpieces as it highlights the ancient monuments like The Golden Gate, Statues of Lions etc.

Apart from visiting above mentioned sites, you can also visit many other monuments like Bouddhanath and Changunarayan which carries historic and cultural importance. Having said this, to really feel the soul of the city we recommend you take a walk through the backstreets, where the capital’s timeless cultural and artistic heritage reveals itself in hidden temples, yards full of chilies and rice and tiny hobbit-sized shops.

title: Kathmandu and Nagarkot Tour
summary: Kathmandu Nagarkot Tour package takes you to the lively and colourful places of Kathmandu and Nagarkot where culture and religion are parts of daily life.

seo.title: Kathmandu and Nagarkot Tour - Base Camp Adventure
seo.description: Kathmandu Nagarkot Tour package takes you to the lively and colourful places of Kathmandu and Nagarkot where culture and religion are parts of daily life.

overview:
The cultural, historical, and scenic exploration of Kathmandu valley and Nagarkot is considered as one of the most enriching tours among the many amazing tours in the natural as well as culturally diverse country, Nepal. While Kathmandu offers rich history and art of ancient times, Nagarkot allows the travelers to witness the most stunning sunrise view along with an alluring vista of the Himalayas, hence inviting many travelers every year.

This tour package will lead you to the fascinating places of Kathmandu and Nagarkot where you will observe various tradition, culture, and religion. This tour begins with the exploration of various UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Kathmandu (also known as the City of Temples). You start exploring the culture of Kathmandu by visiting Swayambhunath temple, one of the most sacred Buddhist shrines in Nepal. The tour continues with a stroll around Kathmandu Durbar Square and Patan Durbar Square, both of which exhibit the ancient art, architecture, and culture of Kathmandu valley. Once used as a palace by the Malla and Lichhavi dynasties, these palaces house many temples and other beautifully crafted monuments on their premises. The tour further takes you to Nagarkot, a hillside situated nearby the valley. Nagarkot is famous for its mesmerizing sunrise and sunset views along with the wide vista of snow-capped mountains like Mt. Everest (8,848 m), Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m), Gaurishankar (7,134 m), Cho Oyu (8,188 m), Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Ganesh Himal (7,422 m), and others.  If you want to have a short adventure, you can hike around Nagarkot, following short trails into dense forests. The tour also features a visit to the Newari city of Bhaktapur, which also houses Bhaktapur Durbar Square. In Bhaktapur, you can enjoy the famous Juju Dhau while watching pottery making. The tour comes to an end with the visit to the Hindu temple of Pashupatinath and Buddhist shrine of Boudhanath.

All in all, this Kathmandu and Nagarkot Tour is intended to offer you a great chance to witness and experience the magnificent nature of rustic Nepal along with superb and captivating view of majestic Mountains living in this excellent region. This short tour will be enough to explore the beauty of nature and history. We assure you that you will be collecting unforgettable experience during this tour.

itinerary.title: Full-day sightseeing tour of Kathmandu and Patan, followed by a drive to Nagarkot (8–9 hours).
itinerary.html: This day will be brightened up after the early morning visit to Swayambhunath, also known as the Monkey Temple. Situated on top of a hill, Swayambhunath emits peaceful vibes and hosts a panoramic view of Kathmandu. Afterward, you will visit another favorite spot of many tourists, Kathmandu Durbar Square. This architectural gem acquaints you with the ancient history of Kathmandu. Then, you will move towards the neighboring city Patan and visit Patan Durbar Square. This is another reminder of the creative era of Kathmandu as it boasts several temple and other monuments, crafted with intricate detailing. After having lunch here, you will be driven towards Nagarkot. En route, you will get views of amazing landscapes and the activities of the local people. After arrival in Nagarkot, you can witness the majesty of the sun setting beyond the hills and the mountains. Overnight in Nagarkot.

itinerary.title: Drive from Nagarkot to Kathmandu, visiting Bhaktapur, Pashupatinath, and Boudhanath along the way (7–8 hours).
itinerary.html: This day will be started by watching the spectacular sunrise over the gorgeous snow-capped mountains and lush hills. Mountains such as Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m), Gaurishankar (7,134 m), and Cho Oyu (8,188 m) can be seen from Nagarkot. In a very clear day Mt Everest also can be seen from Nagarkot. After breakfast, you will head towards Bhaktapur city. Here, you will visit Bhaktapur Durbar Square and also get a close look at the rich Newari culture as you walk through the beautiful alleys lined with traditional houses. Then you will be driven towards Pashupatinath temple and Boudhanath Stupa. Later you will be transferred to the hotel.

seo.description: Explore Nepal’s highlights on our Kathmandu, Pokhara & Chitwan Tour. Discover UNESCO heritage sites, Himalayan views, lakes, wildlife safaris and authentic local culture.

overview:
Kathmandu - Chitwan - Pokhara Tour is one of the best tour packages to explore the diverse nature and culture of Nepal while taking you to three of the major cities of the country. This tour package will lead you to the historically and culturally rich city Kathmandu, the picturesque city of Pokhara, and the abundant wildlife of Chitwan.

The tour begins from Kathmandu (also known as the City of Temples) where seven out of ten UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Nepal is situated. You will visit the prominent places like Pashupatinath, Swayambhunath, Boudhanath, Kathmandu Durbar Square, Bhaktapur Durbar Square, and Patan Durbar Square. These places give you an insight into the rich culture of the ancient rulers of Kathmandu Valley. To experience and observe the culture and lifestyle of the local people of Kathmandu deeply, you will visit different streets full of shops, restaurants, and markets.  From Kathmandu, the tour leads on to Pokhara, also known as the Lake City. The unique combination of snow-clad peaks and radiant lakes has made Pokhara one of the most picturesque natural attractions of Nepal. You can do adventurous activities like paragliding, hiking, boating, bungee jumping, and a helicopter tour in Pokhara. After spending a beautiful time in Pokhara, you head towards Chitwan National Park where you will get closer to wildlife and nature. You can do activities like jungle safari, elephant bathing, bird watching, and canoeing while in Chitwan National Park. You can also visit the traditional Tharu villages and observe Tharu cultural dance performed by the locals.

This trek is known as the tourist destinations of Nepal where you will explore tradition and culture, and nature and wildlife at once. Be a part of this tour with the experienced and caring crew of Base Camp Adventure. We assure you that with us this short trip will become one of the best moments of your life.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu and transfer to hotel.
itinerary.html: You arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu. One of our airport representatives will come and pick you up. Then you will be transferred to the hotel. Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Kathmandu, Bhaktapur, Patan City Tour & Sightseeing (7-8 hours).
itinerary.html: Today you will go for a sightseeing tour around Kathmandu and Bhaktapur City. After breakfast, you will visit Patan Durbar Square, another palace square of the valley where you can observe the beautiful architecture of Krishna Mandir, Vishwanath Temple, and others. And then you will head towards Bhaktapur Durbar Square. You will find unique architectural designs here that remind you of the era gone by. Later, you will travel to Pashupatinath Temple, one of the holy shrines for Hindus. Then you will visit yet another Buddhist shrine, Boudhanath, which is one of the largest stupas in Nepal.  Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: Today you will be transported to Pokhara via Prithvi Highway, zooming past picturesque hills and rivers. Once you reach Pokhara, you can freshen up and stroll around the lakeside area while enjoying the beautiful view of Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) and Annapurna (8,091 m). If you have time and if you are interested, you can also hire a bicycle and cycle around the beautiful lake city. Overnight at a hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Pokhara City Tour & Sightseeing (6-7 hours).
itinerary.html: Rightfully named as the City of Lakes, Pokhara houses many small lakes, among which you will visit two of the most famous lakes. Your day stary with early morning trip to Sarangkot Hill station from where you can see the best panaromic view of Annapurna Range. Thane after breakfast you will go boating in Phewa Lake and visit the Tal Barahi Temple, situated on a land in the middle of the lake. Afterward, you will visit prominent sites like Davis Falls, World Peace Stupa. Later, you head back to the hotel for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara to Chitwan National Park (3-4 hours).
itinerary.html: Today you will leave the beautiful Pokhara city and head towards Chitwan. Upon reaching Chitwan National Park and checking in to the hotel, you will go for canoe trip. Later, you will be enjoying Tharu Cultural Dance, where the locals perform in such a mesmerizing way that it makes you stand up and dance along with them. Overnight in Chitwan.

itinerary.title: Drive from Chitwan to Kathmandu (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: Firstly, will be exploring Chitwan National Park. The park is famous for one horned rhinoceros, Bengal tigers, and different species of birds. You will go for Jungle Safari on a jeep while looking out for a glimpse of the exotic animals in their natural habitat. Afterward, you will also visit the Elephant Breeding Center.  After lunch you will departs for Kathmandu. Overnight in Kathmandu.

seo.description: This trip covers sightings of major sites of Kathmandu & Lhasa. Kathmandu-Lhasa Overland Tour gives you the opportunity to experience many unique cultures.

overview:
Drive in and fly out of Kathmandu-Lhasa overland tour offers fun-filled adventurous journey around cultural heritages and historical places of Nepal and Tibet.

Lhasa, most popularly known as ‘Sunlight City’, is regarded as the heart and soul of Tibet and hence is the number one tourist destination in Tibet. Visits to white and ocher fortress of Potala Palace and Jokhang temple can be quite spiritually rejuvenating experience. Potala Palace is a UNESCO world heritage and features an overwhelming array of intricate murals, temples, stupas, tombs of eight past Dalai Lamas, exquisite Tibetan Mandalas and other relics of Tibetan history. If you wish to glimpse into Tibetan culture, what could be more insightful than exploring Barkhor markets! As you wander around the markets, you witness Tibetan arts, culture, custom and tradition.

With so much to see and explore in Lhasa, this Kathmandu- Lhasa overland tour will truly be an unforgettable experience.

title: Langtang Circuit Trek
summary: Langtang Circuit Trek takes you beyond the usual trails, crossing high passe and traditional routes of Langtang, Gosainkund and Helambu.

seo.title: Langtang Circuit Trek | Langtang Gosainkund Helambu Itinerary
seo.description: Langtang Circuit Trek takes you beyond the usual trails, crossing high passe and traditional routes of Langtang, Gosainkund and Helambu.

overview:
Langtang Circuit Trek is an outstanding blend of panoramic views of the Himalayas rising up to the sky, traversing along picturesque landscapes, and an exposure to the culture and lifestyle of the indigenous Tamang community. Langtang Circuit Trek takes through the beautiful Langtang valley, sacred lake of Gosainkunda, and the hidden Helambu Valley, making this trek adventurous and rewarding. The Langtang Circuit Trek begins after a drive from Kathmandu to Syabru Besi.

The trail of Langtang Circuit Trek presents you the dense forest of rhododendron, oak, and bamboo featuring the rich wildlife of Langtang National Park along with the stunning views of Langtang and Ganesh Himal ranges. The trail thereafter leads you alongside Langtang River and takes you to the various villages in the Langtang Valley, including Langtang village and Kyanjin Gompa. The ancient monastery of Kyanjin is considered the most sacred monastery in the entire region and also offers amazing views of the Langtang and Langshisa ranges. A side trip to Tserko Ri (4,984 m) allows you to get a surreal view of stunning mountains like Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m), Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Langshisha Ri(6,427 m), and so on. The trek then takes you back to Lama Hotel and heads towards Shin Gompa which then takes you to the sacred lake of Gosainkunda.  Every year thousands of pilgrims visit this lake to take a bath in the holy lake for salvation. Especially during the full moon in August, this place is thronged with thousands of Hindu and Buddhist devotees. The trek continues towards the beautiful Helambu valley via Laurebinayak La (4,160 m). Crossing dense rhododendron and oak forests, you reach beautiful villages enriched with pleasant climate and natural beauty until you get back to Kathmandu, marking the end of the trek. Hence, this trek is a combination of Langtang Valley Trekking, Gosainkunda Trekking and Helambu trek, with spectacular Himalayan views, peaceful lakes, thundering rivers, isolated villages, cheerful people and peaceful environment, is truly a heart wrenching trekking route.

Base Camp Adventure is one of the leading travel agencies in the travel and tourism sector of Nepal. With our carefully crafted trips and our experts accompanying you to your trip, we promise to provide you a hassle free and fun-filled holiday in Nepal. All your accommodation and transportation worries are taken care of by the company, so all you got to do is, book a trip and get your backpack ready.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1,400 m / 4,600 ft) and transfer to hotel.
itinerary.html: After your arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, we will be there to welcome you to this Himalayan country. We will then escort you to the hotel. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Sybru Besi (1,503 m / 4,941 ft), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: The drive you take from Kathmandu to Syabru Besi will take about 8 hours. You will witness the natural landscapes while driving along beautiful villages enjoying the view of snow-capped Langtang Himal range. Upon arrival in Syabru Besi, you can rest for a bit and then explore the beautiful town. Overnight in Sybrubensi.

itinerary.title: Trek from Syabru Besi to Lama Hotel (2,410 m / 7,907 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Crossing the Suspension bridge of Bhote Koshi River and walking through the forest is the first step that you take in order to reach Lama Hotel. The route you are trekking in enables you to witness much wildlife. You will pass through bamboo forests and after that the trail is steep. Finally hurdling through steep terrains, you reach Lama Hotel. Overnight in Lama Hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Langtang village (3,430 m / 11,253 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Enjoying the view of Langtang Himal range in the backdrop, today you head towards Langtang, which is the largest Tamang settlement in entire Langtang Region. You will trek alongside Langtang River and through lush rhododendron forest until you reach Ghodatabela. Continuing your trek through uphill climbing, you will reach Langtang village. Overnight in Langtang village.

itinerary.title: Trek from Langtang village to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m / 12,697 ft), 3-4 hours.
itinerary.html: Trek to Kyanjin Gompa is comparatively shorter than the treks you’ve had the earlier days. If you start in the morning from Langtang village, you’ll be able to reach there by lunchtime. The place is famous for cheese production and the ancient monastery of Kyanjin, which is revered as the most sacred monastery by the Tamangs of Langtang region. The monastery also hosts an alluring panorama of the Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Langshisa Ri (6,427 m), and Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m). Overnight in Kyanjin.

itinerary.title: Day trip to Tserko Ri (4,984 m / 16,352 ft) back to Kyanjin Gompa.
itinerary.html: In the morning, you will hike up to Tserko Ri (4,984 m) which provides the beautiful view of various mountains, valleys, and glaciers. The mesmerizing panorama of the Langtang Himal range, Dorje Lakpa range, and Langshisa Ri (6,427 m) seen from the top of Tserko Ri is one of the best views of this trek. You then head back to Kyanjin Gompa and explore the village. You can visit the cheese factory and try fresh cheese as well. Overnight in Kyanjin.

itinerary.title: Trek from Kyanjin Gompa to Lama Hotel (2,470 m / 8,104 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Leaving Kyanjin Gompa behind, you retrace your way back to Lama Hotel following the trails of Langtang River. The trail goes through dense rhododendron forests and passes the villages of Langtang, Ghodatabela, and Gumanechok to reach Lama Hotel. Overnight in Lama Hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Thulo Syabru (2,260 m / 7,415 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: The trail from Lama Hotel to Thulo Syabru goes downhill through bamboo and rhododendron forests. After the gradual descend from Bamboo, you will cross the bridge over the Langtang River and ascend for a while to reach Thulo Syabru. If you are lucky, you may spot a red panda in this trail. Overnight in Thulo Syabru.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thulo Syabru to Sing Gompa/Chandanbari (3,250 m / 10,663 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: This trail of today goes uphill through beautiful rhododendron, bamboo, and pine forest. The Himalayas like Langtang and Ganesh Himal ranges are seen along the route. Then, after a few hours of walk, you will reach Sing Gompa, which is commonly known as Chandanbari. There is a cheese factory in Chandanbari, where you can enjoy the freshly prepared cheese. Overnight in Chandanbari.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sing Gompa to Gosainkunda (4,380 m / 14,370 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Today’s trek is comparatively difficult as you will need to make steep ascends to reach Lauribina. However, the trail is beautiful as it passes through beautiful rhododendron forests. The trail offers the great view of Ganesh Himal (7,422 m), Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), and several other snowy peaks. Although a little challenging, you will find the trek worth it when you reach the serene Gosainkunda Lake. The holy lake is visited by thousands of pilgrims every year and standing beside the lake while immersing in its beauty, you will understand just why the lake is deemed sacred. Overnight in Gosainkunda.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gosainkunda to Ghopte (3,530 m / 11,581 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: From Gosainkunda, the trek goes northeast and takes you to Lauribina Pass (4,610 m). You will get an amazing view of Gosainkunda and the lakes surrounding it as you stand on top of Lauribina La (4,610 m). Crossing the pass, the track heads downhill till you reach Phedi and then the tracks full of ups and downs eventually take you to Ghopte. Overnight in Ghopte.

itinerary.title: Trek from Ghopte to Kutumsang (2,540 m / 8,333 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: From Ghopte to Kutumsang, the trail goes downhill passing through the dense forest of oak, pine, and different types of rhododendron. During the trek, you can also witness beautiful scenery along with the fortunate views of wildlife. Finally, the trail takes you to Kutumsang, which is a small village mainly inhabited by Sherpa people. Overnight in Kutumsang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Kutumsang to Chisapani (2,215 m / 7,267 ft), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: Today you will have to walk through the forest and pass through different villages as you make your way to Chisapani. You will cross small passes like Gul Bhanjyang, Thankune Bhanjyang, and Pati Bhanjyang to enter Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, on whose border Chisapani is situated. Chisapani is the small village that is located beautifully against the snowy peaks of gorgeous mountains. Overnight in Chisapani.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chisapani to Sundarijal (1,460 m / 4,790 ft), followed by a drive to Kathmandu, 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: After enjoying an amazing view of the sun rising over the Himalayas, you leave Chisapani and follow the trail through the forest to reach Sundarijal. You will mostly descend through the lush forest and with the view of rolling hills until you reach the waterfall area of Sundarijal. You will then walk down the stone stairs to reach the bust station in Sundarijal, from where you drive back to Kathmandu and then to your hotel. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Transfer to the airport for your onward journey.
itinerary.html: Today you will be escorted to the international airport for you further departure.

title: Langtang Gosainkunda Helambu Trek
summary: Langtang Gosainkunda Helambu Trek is a comprehensive journey through the Langtang region, offering a beautiful climate, landscapes, and breathtaking himalayan views

seo.title: Langtang Gosainkunda Helambu Trek | Guide, Map and Cost
seo.description: Langtang Gosainkunda Helambu Trek is a comprehensive journey through the Langtang region, offering a beautiful climate, landscapes, and breathtaking himalayan views

overview:
Langtang-Gosainkunda-Helambu Trek is a classic trek that takes you to all the major places of the Langtang region: Langtang valley, Gosainkunda, and Helambu valley. This trek is a perfect blend of nature and culture as it rewards trekkers with lush hills, enchanting Himalayas, and diverse culture of the Tamang and Hyolmo communities; the holy lake of Gosainkunda has its own story to tell. Although long, this trek is easy and can be done by someone without prior trekking experience but with a passionate heart.

The trek begins after your drive from Kathmandu to Syabru Bensi. Following the trails of Langtang River, you first explore the Tamang villages of Langtang valley, including Langtang village which is situated in the lap of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m). Among the many monasteries that you reach during this trek, Kyanjin Gompa, located in the Langtang valley, holds the highest place among the locals of the region and you will uncover the reason when you spend a pleasant evening in the monastery premises. The trek then leads you to the holy lake of Gosainkunda via Sing Gompa and Laurebina.

There are many myths related to Gosainkunda, the most famous one being that this lake was formed by digging the land with the trident of Lord Shiva to collect water to quench his thirst after consuming poison. The lake holds sacred values to the followers of both Hindu and Buddhist religions and is surrounded by several other smaller lakes.

The trek then goes across Gosainkunda Pass (4,610 m) to reach the pristine valley of Helambu, which is inhabited mostly by the Hyolmo people. Helambu valley is very famous for its natural beauty and wonderful climate with the superb views of the magnificent snow-covered mountains. The area covers typical highland Sherpa villages along with beautiful Rhododendron forests. This region extends from the north to Taramarang to the Gosainkund Lake and the lower Jugal Himal from the north. The villages of Melamchi Gaon, Tarkeghyang, and Sermathang along with their ancient monasteries showcase you the lifestyle and culture of the Hyolmo residents. All in all, this trek is the perfect trek for someone seeking spiritual as well as natural serenity.

Base Camp Adventure is a leading travel agency in Nepal which has been successful in organizing and facilitating many treks and tours in Nepal over a course of ten years. We take your safety and comfort seriously hence we make the arrangements accordingly. Our local guides help you to build the intimate relationship with the local people so that you can immerse in your journey thoroughly. So, for an authentic travel experience in Nepal, remember Base Camp Adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu (1,400 m / 4,600 ft) and transfer to your hotel.
itinerary.html: Upon your arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, you will be welcomed by one of our office representatives who will then transfer you to your hotel. Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Syabru Besi (1,503 m / 4,941 ft), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: After a hearty breakfast, you will get on with your drive to Syabru Besi. Enjoying the constantly changing landscapes, you drive on a pitched road and later on the off-road trail to reach SyabruBbesi via Dhunche. Enjoy the emerging view of Langtang Himal range from Syabru Besi. Overnight in Syabru Besi.

itinerary.title: Trek from Syabru Besi to Lama Hotel (2,410 m / 7,907 ft), 6-7 Hours.
itinerary.html: Your trek starts today as you move out of Syabru Besi to reach Lama Hotel. Cross Trishuli River on a suspension bridge and then follow Langtang River upstream through the lush forest of rhododendron and bamboo while being accompanied by the views of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m) to finally arrive in Lama Hotel. Overnight in Lama Hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Langtang Village (3,430 m / 11,253 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: The trekking trail from Lama Hotel to Langtang village features many Tamang villages located peacefully on the banks of Langtang River with a backdrop of Naya Kanga (5,844 m) on one side and Langtang II (6,596 m) on the other side. Apart from the villages, the lush forest filled with rhododendron and pine trees make your trail to Langtang village a pleasant one. Overnight in Langtang village.

itinerary.title: Trek from Langtang Village to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m / 12,697 ft), 3-4 hours.
itinerary.html: After Langtang village, you will move to Kyanjin Gumba. There are various things you can see and observe on your way like water mills, scared rocks with Buddhist inscriptions, and so on. Through the forested trail on the foothills of the Langtang Himal range, you finally reach Kyanjin Gumba, which is the oldest and the most sacred monastery in Langtang region. The monastery also hosts an amazing view of snowy mountains that glisten behind the barren landscape. Overnight in Kyanjin Gumba.

itinerary.title: Day excursion to Tserko Ri (4,984 m / 16,352 ft) and return to Kyanjin Gompa, 3-4 hours.
itinerary.html: Today you will take go on a day trip to Tserko Ri (4,984 m). You walk through the meadows and through rocky lands to reach the top of Tserko Ri (4,984 m), which serves as an amazing vantage point to view various snow-clad mountains like Langtang Himal range, Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m), and Langshisa Ri (6,560 m). Afterward, you hike back to Kyanjin Gumba for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Trek from Kyanjin Gompa to Lama Hotel (2,470 m / 8,104 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Today you retrace your way from Kyanjin Gumba through lush forests and past the settlements of Langtang village, Ghodatabela, and Gumanechok to finally reach Lama Hotel. The beautiful Langtang River keeps you company throughout the trek. Overnight in Lama Hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Thulo Syabru (2,260 m / 7,415 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: You will follow the Langtang River all the way to Pahare Khola. The trail goes through the stunning forest of bamboo and rhododendron and gives you a chance to spot the rare red panda. From Pahare Hotel, you leave Langtang River and ascend through the forest to reach the Tamang village of Thulo Syabru. Overnight in Thulo Syabru.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thulo Syabru to Sing Gompa/Chandanbari (3,250 m / 10,663 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: You make your way to Sing Gompa ascending on the ridges through the deep forests with mixed vegetation. En route, you reach Dursagang and Phulung Gompa before ascending steeply to reach Shin Gompa, which is located in the picturesque village of Chandanbari. Overnight in Sing Gompa.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sing Gompa to Gosainkunda (4,380 m / 14,370 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: As you leave Shin Gompa, you will first reach the village of Chyolangpati, which is famous for its cheese production. You then continue to ascend through the forest to reach Laurebina, from where you make a steep ascend to reach a 4,165 m high pass that takes you first to Saraswati Kund and then to Bhairab Kund. Finally, an easy walk on a flat trail brings you to the holy lake of Gosaikunda. The turquoise freshwater lake is considered as a pilgrimage site by the followers of Hindu as well as Buddhist religion. Enjoy the peaceful environment around the pristine lake. Overnight in Gosainkunda.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gosainkunda to Ghopte (3,530 m / 11,581 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Leaving the beautiful Gosainkunda behind, today you pass a few small lakes as you ascend to reach Lauribina Pass (4,610 m). You can get an amazing view of various lakes surrounding Gosainkunda while standing on top of Lauribina La (4,610 m). You will then descend steeply to reach Phedi, from where you walk through the forest to finally reach Ghopte. Overnight in Ghopte.

itinerary.title: Trek from Ghopte to Melamchi Gaon (2,530 m / 8,301 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Today you will follow the trail through the verdant forest of Soli Danda. Many clear streams are crossed during this easy trek. You come across a small cave before reaching Thadepati Pass (3,690 m). Enjoy the view of Helambu valley from the top of the pass. Descending left route from Thadepati, you make your way to Melamchi Gaon through the quiet forest with the views if small villages in distant hillsides. You cross small streams enjoying their soothing south amid the pin-drop silence. Then, finally, a gradual climb through the forest of rhododendron and oak brings you to the beautiful Melamchi Gaon. Overnight in Melamchi Gaon.

itinerary.title: Trek from Melamchi Gaon to Tarkeghyang (2,600 m / 8,530 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Moving on from Melamchi Gaon, you head on to reach the Hyolmo village of Tarkeghyang, also known as Helambu. The trail goes through the deep forest of rhododendron which is dotted with small monasteries and Chortens. Upon reaching Tarkeghyang, you can visit the ancient Gekye Gompa to get a glimpse of the practices of the Hyolmo community. Overnight in Tarkeghyang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tarkeghyang to Sermathang (2,590 m / 8,497 ft), 4-5 hours.
itinerary.html: You head on to another Hyolmo village in the Helambu valley, that is, Sermathang. As you descend, you reach the monastery in Ghangyul, from where you cross a Mani wall and climb down gradually to reach Chimighyang. Then a pleasant walk on a flat trail through the forest brings you to Sermathang. Overnight in Sermathang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sermathang to Melamchi Bazaar (870 m / 2,854 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: From Sermathang, the trail descends steeply to reach Melamchi Bazar. Passing many temples and monasteries, you cross small villages before reaching the confluence of Melamchi River and Indrawati River, across which the small town of Melamchi is situated. Overnight in Melamchi Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Bus drive from Melamchi Bazaar to Kathmandu.
itinerary.html: Today you will drive back to Kathmandu from Melamchi Bazaar. Enjoy the scenery of the hillsides and the terraced farms along with various river gorges on your way to Kathmandu. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu.
itinerary.html: We will drop you off at the airport 3 hours prior to your scheduled flight.

title: Langtang Gosainkunda Trek
summary: Langtang Gosainkunda Trek is one of the major treks of the Langtang region. Gosainkunda Lake has unique combination of natural beauty and culture richness.

seo.title: Langtang Gosainkunda Trek | Gosaikunda Lake Trek in Nepal
seo.description: Langtang Gosainkunda Trek is one of the major treks of the Langtang region. Gosainkunda Lake has unique combination of natural beauty and culture richness.

overview:
Langtang Gosainkunda Trek is perfect for the trekkers who want to explore both nature and culture without having to travel far from the bustling Kathmandu city. From the traditional Tamang villages of Langtang valley to the pristine lake of Gosainkunda to the mesmerizing view of the snowy peaks of the Langtang Himal Range, Langtang Gosainkunda Trek seems to have it all. As one of the easiest treks in Nepal, this trek is perfect for everyone from experienced trekkers to novices.

The Langtang Gosainkunda Trek begins after a drive from Kathmandu to Sybrubensi. The trek follows the trails of Langtang River heading towards Langtang Himalayan Range and the Tibetan border. Passing through several small Tamang settlements, the trek takes you to the beautiful Langtang village, situated in the lap of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m). From Langtang village, the trek continues to Kyanjin Gompa, which is the most sacred monastery of the entire Langtang region. The trek then follows the trail through Lama Hotel, Thulo Syabru, and Shin Gompa to reach the final destination, Gosainkunda. Gosainkunda is a sacred lake for Hindu and Buddhist devotees, and it has a fascinating combination of cultural abundance and natural beauty.

In the festival called Janai Purnima, which falls during the month of August, hundreds and thousands of pilgrims visit this place to take a bath in the holy water of Gosainkunda. They believe taking a bath in the lake helps them be free of their sins. Climbing up and down the many hills on this trek, you will pass through stunning rhododendron and alpine forests with vast species of flora and fauna. You will witness diverse landscapes including radiant waterfalls, barren hillsides, evergreen forests, and many rivers and their tributaries.

Base Camp Adventure has been organizing various successful treks and tours all around Nepal for more than a decade. A trusted name in the Nepalese tourism industry, the team of Base Camp Adventure works to give you a comfortable and pleasant trekking experience in the natural and culturally abundant Nepal.

Langtang Gosainkunda Trek Altitude Chart

itinerary.title: Arrive at Tribhuwan International Airport (TIA), Kathmandu (1,400 m / 4,600 ft)and transfer to hotel.
itinerary.html: Upon arriving at the airport in Kathmandu, you will be greeted and taken to your hotel by our representatives.

itinerary.title: Bus drive from Kathmandu to Syabru Besi (1,503 m / 4,941 ft), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: Today, drive to Syabru Besi, the starting point of your Langtang Valley Trek. Enjoy the scenic journey along winding mountain roads, with beautiful landscapes and, weather permitting, stunning views of the Langtang and Ganesh Himal ranges. Overnight in Syabru Besi.

itinerary.title: Trek from Syabru Besi (1600 m) to Lama Hotel (2470 m), 5-6 hours
itinerary.html: Descend to cross the suspension bridge over Bhote Koshi River and then follow Langtang River through the forested trail to reach Lama Hotel. The trail is mostly covered with innumerous rhododendron and bamboo trees. A gradual climb alongside the river brings you to Lama Hotel, where you will be staying for the night.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Langtang village (3,430 m / 11,253 ft.) via Ghoda Tabela, 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Climb uphill to get the view of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m) en route to Ghoda Tabela. From Ghoda Tabela, the trail widens and passes few herders’ settlements. As you will be walking inside Langtang National Park, you will find the path full of various flora and fauna. Upon reaching the picturesque Langtang village, you will be able to get an up-close view of the Langtang Himal Range, which sits peacefully behind the traditional houses of the village. Overnight in Langtang village.

itinerary.title: Trek from Langtang Village to Kyanjin Gumba (3,870 m / 12,697 ft), 3-4 hours.
itinerary.html: Climb gradually to pass the villages, yak pastures, streams, and moraines to reach Kyanjin Gompa. In Kyanjin Gompa, you will visit its ancient monastery that is considered the most significant of the locals in Langtang. The whitewashed monastery looks even more brilliant when you notice the snowy mountains like the Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m), and others emerge in the backdrop. Overnight in Kyanjin Gompa.

itinerary.title: Day excursion to Tesrko Ri (4,984 m / 16,352 ft) and back to Jyanjin Gumba.
itinerary.html: Today is the day when you rest and explore the Kyanjin vicinity and Tesrko Ri (4,984 m) For a better view of Langtang Himal range, Langshisa Ri (6,560 m), Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m), and may other snow-capped mountain peaks, you can hike up to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,984 m). You can later hike back down to Kyanjin Gompa and explore the beautiful village. Overnight in Kyanjin Gompa.

itinerary.title: Trek from Kyanjin Gompa to Lama Hotel (2,470 m / 8,104 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: After the amazing stay in Kyanjin Gompa, you retrace your way back to Lama Hotel. Following Langtang River downstream, you first reach Langtang village and then Ghodatabela, from where a gradual descend along the forest takes you back to Lama Hotel. Overnight in Lama Hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel (2470m.) to Thulo Syabru (2,260 m / 7,415 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Today is the easiest day of this trek. You begin to descend on a forested trail that leads you to the ridge above Langtang River, from where you ascend uphill to reach Thulo Syabru. En route, you may spot a red panda or some monkeys. Enjoy the peaceful ambiance of the Tamang village of Thulo Syabru. Overnight in Thulo Syabru.

itinerary.title: Trek from Thulo Syabru to Sing Gompa (3,250 m / 10,663 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Ascend along the ridge of Phulung Danda and pass some scattered settlements like Garta and Dursagang. Walking through the oak, hemlock, and fir forests, you reach Phulung Gompa. After spending some time at Phulung Gompa, you head up to reach Shin Gompa in Chandanbari. Overnight in Sing Gompa.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sing Gompa to Gosainkunda (4,380 m / 14,370 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: The first part of the trail ascends up to Lauribinayak La (3,920 m) then the trail steeply descends to reach the tranquil Gosainkunda. Passing through Saraswatikunda and Bhairab Kunda, you reach the holy lake of Gosainkunda, which is visited by many Hindu and Buddhist pilgrims every year. Overnight in Gosainkunda.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gosaikunda to Sing Gompa (3,250 m / 10,663 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Descend through the lush forest all the way to Shin Gompa via Lauribinayak enjoying magnificent mountain views. You can stop for a while in Cholangpati to visit the local cheese factory and try some of the fresh cheese, or even buy some to take back home. Overnight in Sing Gompa.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sing Gompa/Chandan Bari to Dhunche (1,950 m / 6,398 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Descend through pine, silver oak, and rhododendron forests and cross the suspension bridge over Trishuli River. Enjoy the paths through some human settlements and mineral water factories until you reach Dhunche, a small town and the headquarters of Rasuwa district. Overnight in Dhunche.

itinerary.title: Drive from Dhunche to Kathmandu (1,400 m / 4,600 ft), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: This day marks as a victory and accomplishment for everybody. You can show gratitude to the porters or the team members by offering tips. You then drive back to Kathmandu and rest for the day. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Airport for your onward destination.
itinerary.html: After a quick photo, you will be dropped at the airport 3 hours prior to your flight time.

seo.description: Are you desiring to visit Langtang valley but don’t have enough time for trekking? Then the Langtang Helicopter tour is a great choice.

overview:
Are you desiring to visit Langtang valley but don’t have enough time for trekking? Then the Langtang Helicopter tour brought to you by Base Camp Adventure is a great choice.

Recently Helicopter tours are gaining popularity in the trekking world. You can visit many major trekking destinations within a few hours limit and return to Kathmandu.

In this Langtang Helicopter tour, you will be flying over the Langtang glaciers and reach Kyanjin Gompa. After arriving there, you will explore the area and take marvelous pictures.

For the entire trip, you will be surrounded by several magnificent peaks, landscapes, and valleys. Some of the mountains are Langtang Lirung, Gaurishankar, Lakpaa Dorje, Yala Peak, Naya Kanga, and many more.

Visiting the Yak cheese factory and Kyanjin Gompa is one of the major highlights of this trek. You will be visiting one of the oldest monasteries of this region and exploring the area quickly.

Langtang Heli tour is an escape to the beauty of nature. Long walks in the trails can be hectic, so this helicopter tour is like a cheat. Flying above the Langtang National Park, viewing the lush green forests is one of the major attractions.

The scenic heli tour begins and ends in Kathmandu. Boarding your flight from the Tribhuvan airport, it flies in the direction of northward towards the Langtang range. You will be viewing splendid scenarios of the glistening white peaks, valleys, and landscapes.

So don’t think much and just plan this Langtang helicopter tour for your vacation. Get ready to be lost in the beauty of nature while viewing the beautiful Himalayas ranges.

About Langtang Valley

Langtang Valley is one of the nearest trekking destinations from Kathmandu. It lies about 51 km away from Kathmandu in the north-central Himalayas of Bagmati.

Langtang valley is popular for hosting Langtang National park. This park acts as a border with Tibet. Langtang National park is the first Himalayan national park in Nepal.

The government built this national park to protect the flora and faunas and preserve the unique culture, tradition, and lifestyle. The people living in this region still depend upon the forest woods for fire.

The areas are mostly inhabited by the Tamang community, which is influenced by the Tibetan culture and tradition. People from other communities such as Rai, Sherpa, Newar, Brahmins, etc also live here.

Langtang Valley is known for its remote and exotic trekking routes. The trekking routes take about a week off your schedule. So, if you have enough time, you can visit various trekking destinations of this Langtang valley.

Highlights of Langtang Helicopter Tour

  • Views of snowy peaks including Mt. Langtang Lirung, Gaurishankar, Yala Peak, Naya Kanga, Lakpa Dorje, Ganesh Himal, and many more
  • Reach Kyanjin Gompa
  • Visit the yak cheese factory.
  • Scenic flight for the entire Helicopter tour
  • Stunning aerial views of the Langtang valley
  • Fantastic scenarios of green hills, lush forest, rocky landscapes, etc

itinerary.title: Langtang Helicopter Tour Itinerary
itinerary.html: <h2>Phase 01: Pick up from the Hotel and drop off at the airport.</h2> Langtang Helicopter tour is about <strong>1 to 2 hours</strong> long. Even after visiting and exploring the region, you will have the rest of the day to yourself. To know more about the Langtang Heli Tour itinerary in detail, read further below: Waking up early, you freshen up and get ready for your Langtang helicopter tour. Your tour guide will pick you up from the hotel and drop you off at the airport. The flights are held early morning to avoid windy and stormy weather conditions during the daytime. <h2>Phase 02: Fly from Kathmandu to Langtang Valley</h2> Arriving at the airport, you check-in and board the flight beginning your journey towards the Langtang valley. Leaving the noisy city behind, you fly north towards the Himalayan range. As you soar into the sky, you can see the beautiful Kathmandu valley and a few of the UNESCO heritage sites below. You will be flying above the Langtang National Park on this tour. After flying for some minutes, you get to see the stunning snowy peaks. The helicopter ride takes you towards the Langtang valley while Enjoying the scenic views. Langtang is a gorgeous valley located in the north-central Himalayas. You get a glimpse of the lush green valley surrounded by gigantic Himalayas and glaciers from the ride. Enjoying the aerial views of the valley, you fly over the Langtang glaciers. The helicopter ride takes you closer to the Himalayan range. The glistening peaks look super amazing out your window. You can capture the moments in the photograph. <h2>Phase 03: Land at Kyanjin Gompa, then Explore around the valley.</h2> Viewing the luscious scenarios, you finally land at Kyanjin Gompa after a<strong> 30 to 35 minutes</strong> ride. You will stay and explore this area for another 30 minutes. So, have some fun. Kyanjin Gompa, residing at an altitude of<strong> 3,817 m above sea level, </strong>is one of this region’s old monasteries. The Himalayas look fantastic on the backdrop of the beautiful Gompa. Trekkers usually acclimatize here and hike up to Tsergo Ri, residing at <strong>5,150 m</strong> above sea level. This place also has an excellent viewpoint at an elevation of <strong>4,600 m</strong>. From Kyanjin Gompa, you will visit the Yak cheese factory. This factory is centuries old and a significant attraction for people visiting the <a href="https://basecampadventure.com/destinations/nepal/langtang-region/">Langtang region</a>. You can try out the cheese and bring back some as well. You will have your breakfast here. The warm welcome and friendly hospitality will win your heart. The villages of this area are still remote, so; they have a unique lifestyle, culture, and tradition. You get to see peaks such as Langtang Lirung, Ganesh Himal, and many more from here. Enjoy the moment and capture these memories. <h2>Phase 04: Flight Back to Kathmandu</h2> After making several memories, you now board the helicopter returning to Kathmandu. You fly back, savoring the scenic views of rivers, glaciers, Himalayas, gorges, forests, etc. The beautiful views are an exciting part of the trip. After a half an hour flight, you land in <a href="https://basecampadventure.com/trip/kathmandu-city-day-tour/">Kathmandu</a>. <h2> Phase 05: Pick up from Airport and Drop off at the Hotel</h2> After landing at the airport, your guide will pick you up from there and drop you off at your hotel. We hope the Langtang Helicopter tour was exciting for you. If you have longer days, then you can choose the Langtang valley trek as well.

sections.title: Best time for Helicopter Tour in Langtang Region
sections.html:
There are four seasons throughout the year in the Nepal context, i.e., Spring, Autumn, Winter, and Monsoon. You can choose any of the seasons for the Langtang Helicopter Tour.

Among them, Spring and Autumn are the peak season of the year. The clear weather, outstanding views of peaks and landscapes are some of the reasons. During these seasons, the climatic conditions make the helicopter tour worth it.

To know more about the seasons, read further below:

Spring season

It brings a new beginning along with it. The lost greenery of the hills, beauty of nature, buds of flowers, lush forests is some of them. The month of March, April, May fall under this season.

The weather and temperature are very favorable during these months. The skies are clear and sunny, giving the best view of your surroundings. The temperature ranges from 20 degrees to 5 degrees in this region.

Autumn Season

Autumn is the most popular season among the others. The trails and flights are filled with visitors from all around the world. During this season, the bloomed flowers, green hills, and magnificent peaks look mesmerizing. The month of September, October, November fall under this season.

And the festive season is right around the corner, so; it adds flavor to the helicopter tour. The weather is best during this time with clear blue skies and bright days. The temperature ranges from 10 degrees to 2 degrees during Autumn. Early mornings are a bit chilly during this time.

Winter Season

Winter is the off-season time for trekking and mountain flights. So, the routes and flights are not as packed as other seasons. The months of December, January, February fall under this season.

This season is the time for snowfall in elevation above 2,000 m. So, heavy snowfall occurrences at higher altitudes cause flight cancellation and delays. However, you can do the Langtang Heli tour during early December and late February.

The skies are clear, and the days are windy, bright, and warm. But the temperature drops below the freezing point as you reach higher in elevation. So, it gets colder with every climb.

Monsoon Season

Monsoon is the least preferred season for mountain flights due to continuous rainfall and obstructed view. But the helicopter tour is not impossible during this season. As summer and monsoon fall at the same time.

June, July and August are the months in Monsoon. Flight delays and cancellations are usual during these months. And the views hidden behind the dark clouds can be disappointing.

But due to regular rainfall, you can see new species of flora on the forest paths. Also, mountain flights are possible during early June and late August.

The earlier weeks of June indicate the beginning of the summer season, so the weather is sunny and hot during these times. While by late August, the monsoon will have ended, clearing the dark clouds.

You may also like:

  • Nepal Luxury Tour Package
  • Annapurna Base Camp Helicopter Tour with Landing
  • Everest Base Camp Helicopter Tour

Langtang Helicopter Tour difficulties

Altitude sickness

There is a low possibility of suffering from altitude sickness in the Langtang Helicopter tour. But some people suffer from AMS when reaching elevation above 2,500 m.

You won’t have any acclimatization when going on a helicopter tour. So, the sudden elevation change can cause problems for some travelers. However, not everyone suffers from this, so be calm.

If you suffer from breathing difficulty, nausea, dizziness, etc., during the land, then immediately inform the crewmate. They will give you proper instruction on how to overcome AMS and decide whether to return or stay.

Bad Weather condition

Unlike treks, weather plays a vital role when going on a helicopter tour. If the weather conditions are bad, there are high chances of flight delays and cancellations.

Also, the tour might be less exciting due to obstructed views and humidity. You can face this problem when traveling during winter and the monsoon. So, always read the weather forecast before making plans for the trip.

Pack during Peak season

One of the difficulties will be booking immediate flights during peak season. As trekkers and travelers will pre-book the routes and flights during this time.

Also, the destinations will be swarming with trekkers visiting the region. So, you might not get privacy and have to wait to click decent pictures. Autumn and Spring are the peak seasons, so be prepared to adjust to crowds.

faqs.q: When is the best time for a Langtang Helicopter Tour?
faqs.a: Langtang Helicopter tour is suitable any time of the year, but people consider <strong>Spring and Autumn the best time</strong>. The weather and temperature are favorable for mountain flights during these seasons. There are few chances of delays and cancellations. To know more about the Langtang helicopter tour’s best time, you can read above in the article.

faqs.q: How much time does the flight take to reach Kyanjin Gompa from Kathmandu?
faqs.a: The flight takes about <strong>30 to 35 minutes to reach Kyanjin Gompa</strong> from Kathmandu. But the duration can change according to the weather conditions.

faqs.q: What is the highest point of this Helicopter tour?
faqs.a: <strong>Kyanjin Gompa is the highest point</strong> you will be reaching in this helicopter tour. This Gompa resides at an altitude of 3,817 m

faqs.q: Does this helicopter tour have any age limit?
faqs.a: <strong>No, </strong>this helicopter tour doesn’t have any age limit. It is fit for any age group as you don’t have to make long and tiring up and downhill walks.

faqs.q: Do we face any difficulty in this Langtang Helicopter Tour?
faqs.a: Yes, you will be facing some difficulties in this Langtang Helicopter tour. You might not be trekking in the routes, but still,<strong> bad weather, AMS, packed paths </strong>are challenging.

faqs.q: Is Altitude SIckness a problem when going on the Langtang Helicopter tour?
faqs.a: We can’t precisely say Altitude sickness will be a problem in this Langtang Helicopter tour. But yes, it can cause suffering for some as you will be directly reaching an altitude above 3,000 m You won’t have acclimatized to get to this elevation, so <strong>instant exposure to high altitude can cause AMS.</strong> Thus to reduce the possibility of altitude sickness, 30 minutes of ground time is allocated. You won’t be staying more than the given time in these areas.

faqs.q: What measures will you use if anyone suffers from Altitude sickness?
faqs.a: In case of altitude sickness, <strong>first-aid treatment will be provided</strong> by the crew member. And if the condition worsens, you will be transferred to Kathmandu or lower altitudes.

faqs.q: Is a helicopter tour during winter and monsoon possible?
faqs.a: Yes, a Helicopter <strong>tour during winter and monsoon is possible</strong>. But there are high chances of flight cancellation and delays due to bad weather. So, early June, late August, early December, and late February are the months for a heli tour during these seasons.

faqs.q: Will the Helicopter wait for the passengers if they are late for boarding?
faqs.a: There are a few chances of getting late, but <strong>they will wait for the passenger</strong> in case that happens.

faqs.q: Is the Langtang Helicopter tour safe?
faqs.a: Yes, the <strong>Langtang Helicopter tour is very safe</strong> as we consider our client’s safety first. The flights operate only after a thorough weather inspection and wind direction. The flights are regularly maintained and flown by expert pilots who have years of experience.

faqs.q: How many stops do we make in this heli tour?
faqs.a: The destination is very close to Kathmandu valley, so we won’t be making more than one stop. We will only land in Kyanjin Gompa.

seo.description: Langtang Valley Trek offers stunning mountain views, lush forests, traditional villages, and rich Tamang culture.

overview:
Langtang Valley Trek is one of the most popular short treks in Nepal. Located in the north of Kathmandu, Langtang Valley Trek is an easy and fun trek that offers glorious views of the gorgeous Langtang Himal range. The trek takes you to the beautiful valley bound by Langtang River and allows you to observe the Tamang way of life hence making this a perfect holiday trek.

Langtang Valley is rich with many beautiful landscapes and places worth exploring. The isolated and peculiar landscape of Langtang Valley has made it a rewarding trek which begins after an 8 hours’ drive from Kathmandu to Sybrubensi. The trail of this trek leads you into the dense forests of pine and Rhododendron, crossing alpine pastures and observing the diverse range of flora and fauna found inside the Langtang National Park. The presence of lovely villages and ancient monasteries add charm to this trek.

The trail goes through many Tamang villages before reaching Langtang village, a quiet village nestled in the foothill of Langtang Lirung (7,229 m). One of the major highlights of this trek is the visit to Kyanjin Gompa, which is famous for the production of local yak cheese at Yala Cheese Factory, but more than that Kyanjin Gompa is the most loved among the local Tamangs for its spiritual significance. The view of the surrounding mountains looks mystical as they stand tall behind the Gompa. A side trip to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,984 m) offers the most amazing view of the Langtang range and other peaks. After enjoying the perks of Langtang Valley, the trek ends as you head back to Syabru Besi via Lama Hotel and move to Kathmandu with memories that will never fade away.

Base Camp Adventure, having conducted many treks and tours around the country for more than a decade, is committed to quality service. We take care of your transportation, accommodation, and permits along with any other valid travel requirements. With our fun and friendly guides, you will have the most amazing time of your life while trekking in Nepal.

Langtang Valley Trek Altitude Chart

itinerary.title: Arrive at Tribhuwan International Airport (TIA), Kathmandu (1,400 m / 4,600 ft) and transfer to hotel.
itinerary.html: Upon arrival in Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, you will be warmly greeted by our office representative who will then take you to hotel. O/N at a hotel.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Syabru Besi (1,503 m / 4,941 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Leaving Kathmandu, you will drive to Syabru Besi, which is the beginning point of the trek to Langtang Valley. The roads are quite uneven and windy yet entertaining. Experience the amazing view of Langtang and Ganesh Himal ranges en route to Syabru Besi. Enjoy the serene environment of the beautiful town of Syabru Besii. Stay overnight in Syabru Besi.

itinerary.title: Trek from Syabru Besi to Lama Hotel (2,470 m / 8,104 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Descend to Bhote Koshi River and cross the suspension bridge to enter Langtang Valley. Follow Langtang River upstream through the lush forest of rhododendron and bamboo and pass through scattered settlements to reach Lama Hotel. Enjoy the view of Naya Kang (5,844 m) and Langtang II (5,696 m) from Lama Hotel. Stay Overnight in Lama Hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Langtang village (3,430 m / 11,253 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Ascend gradually to the narrow track that takes you further to Langtang village, a Tamang village with the attractive view of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m), rhododendron forests, agro fields, and stone thatched houses with yaks and wild goats as their pets. Explore the village and the amazing surrounding. Overnight in Langtang village.

itinerary.title: Trek from Langtang Village to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870 m / 12,697 ft), 3-4 hours.
itinerary.html: Leaving Langtang village behind, you continue your trek alongside Langtang River to reach Kyanjin Gompa. A few ascends and descends take you to the ancient monastery which is deemed the most sacred by the Tamang locals of Langtang valley. Kyanjin Gompa also hosts amazing views of the Langtang range along with other snowy peaks like Dorje Lakpa (6,966 m), and Langshisa Ri (6,560 m). Stay overnight in Langtang village.

itinerary.title: Extra day at Kyanjin Gompa for an excursion to Tserko Ri (4,984 m / 16,352 ft).
itinerary.html: Today you take a day off trekking to explore the outskirts of Kyanjin Gompa. You can hike up to Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) and Tserko Ri (4,984 m) for a stunning view of the surrounding mountains. You can later explore the monastery and local cheese factory of Kyanjin while interacting with the locals of the village. Stay overnight in Kyanjin Gompa.

itinerary.title: Trek back from Kyanjin Gompa to Lama Hotel (2,470 m / 8,104 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: After a wonderful stay in Kyanjin, you retrace your way back to the Lama Hotel through the trails alongside Langtang River. Walk through lush rhododendron forests and pass Langtang village and Ghoda Tabela to arrive in Lama Hotel. Stay overnight in a guest house Lama Hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lama Hotel to Syabru Besi (1,503 m / 4,941 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Continue to retrace your trail alongside Langtang River as you make your way towards Sybru Besi. Mesmerizing view of mountains, green landscape, and the Tamang villages adorn your way. Descend gradually and then steeply on a ridge above Langtang River to reach Sybru Besi. Overnight at a local guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Drive by bus from Syabru Besi to Kathmandu (1,400 m / 4,600 ft), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: Today you drive back to Kathmandu enjoying the view of Trishuli River for the most part of the journey. The view of the local villages and the green landscape zooming of beside you is certainly heavenly to look at. Upon reaching Kathmandu, you will be transferred to your hotel. Afterward, feel free to stroll around and explore the city. Overnight in a hotel.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Airport for your onward journey.
itinerary.html: After breakfast, you will be taken to the airport for your scheduled flight to your onward destination.
