overview:
Trip Details

Nagarkot hiking day tour is an interesting day tours in Nepal. After 40 minute of drive from Kathmandu you reach to Sakhu bazaar then you commence your hike from Sakhu Bazar and take you to the hill retreat of Nagarkot, perched on a ridge 32 km east of Kathmandu. The trail climbs up to the tower of Nagarkot. Four direction’s superb view from the tower makes your day tour an excellent memory and especially the view of lofty Himalayan ranges including Mt Everest on east and Kahmandu valley on west. The way is gentle going up and you will enjoy looking the view. It commands sweeping views of the Himalayas. Five of the world’s ten highest peaks, Everest, Lhotse, Choyu, Makalu and Manaslu are viewed from here. Nagarkot is such a popular spot to watch sunrise orsunset of every day. After enjoying the view from Nagarkor we will be picked up by a transport to back to Kathmandu.

title: Narphu Valley Trek
summary: Nar Phu valley and Thorang La Pass Trek is probably the best trek of Annapurna Region for those who want to explore hidden valley with high passes.

seo.title: Nar Phu valley and Thorang La Pass Trek - Base Camp Adventure Treks
seo.description: Nar Phu valley and Thorang La Pass Trek is probably the best trek of Annapurna Region for those who want to explore hidden valley with high passes.

overview:
Nar Phu Valley Trekking is a special trekking area of Nepal as it is a combination of the quaint villages of Nar and Phu, amazing landscapes, and unique Himalayan culture. It is a fantastic journey to the wild and unexplored neighborhood filled with wide-ranging Himalayan scenery that takes you through Kang La Pass (5,320 m) and Thorung La pass (5,416 m). Nar Phu Valley Trek is the best trekking route in Annapurna region for those who want to travel through off the beaten tracks and explore hidden valleys.

Nar Phu valley trail passes through antique Gompas, narrow canyons, and ethnic culture of Tibetan influenced inhabitants. You will encounter with blue sheep, mules, and yaks during the trek. Buddhism is the most common religion in this region. You can witness the culture of the mountain people in the region which has blossomed even after centuries of hardships.

Tashi Lhakhang Monastery and many other age-old monasteries make your trek a cultural exploration too. The villages of Nar and Phu take you back in time with their traditional housing style in the rugged terrain made of sandy hills.

A traverse through Thorung La Pass (5,416 m), a frozen mountain pass on the foot of Thorung Peak (6,144 m), takes you to Muktinath, an important Hindu, and Buddhist pilgrimage site. The trek provides you with an incredible opportunity to view Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges along with other snow-capped peaks as you explore the various settlements reached en route. A flight through the Kali Gandaki Gorge from Jomsom marks the end of Nar Phu Valley Trek.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Kathmandu airport and transfer to hotel
itinerary.html: Once you land at Tribhuvan International Airport, our representative will pick you at the arrival section. You will be transferred to the hotel via private van. Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Bus drive from Kathmandu to Bhulbhule (840 m / 2,756 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: You will drive from Kathmandu to Bhulbhule, a small Gurung settlement in Lamjung.  The scenic drive will take around 6 hours to reach Bhulbhule. Along the way, you will be accompanied by Trishuli River for the first part and Marsayangdi River for the latter half. The road is excellent up to Besi Sahar. From there, the road to Bhulbhule is off-track for about 45 minutes. Overnight in Bhulbhule.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bhulbhule to Chyamche (11,430 m / 4,692 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: As you start your trek, you will follow the rocky trail leading towards a beautiful waterfall. Then cross the suspension bridge and climb towards Ngadi and then to Bahundanda. After a short break, descend along the bank of Marsayangdi River. After crossing another suspension bridge, climb up to Jagat. From there, a short hike through the forest will take you to Chyamche. Overnight in Chyamche.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chamje to Dharapani (1,860 m / 6,102 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Trek along the narrow and steep trail towards enchanting rhododendron, bamboo, and pine forest. You may get to see mules along the way. Cross a suspension bridge over the snaky Marsayangdi River. Reach the beautiful village of Tal and continue the trek uphill until you reach Dharapani. You will have an amazing view of Lamjung Himal (6,983 m) and Annapurna II (7,937 m) as you rest in Dharapani for the night.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dharapani to Koto (2,600 m / 8,530 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: It will be a 7 hours trek from Dharapani to Koto. After 30 minutes of walk, you reach Bagarchhap. You can see the views of Manaslu (8,163 m), Lamjung Himal (6,983 m), and Annapurna II (7,937 m). Further trek to Manang valley and the path uphill is flat until Thanchowk. From there, you will make a gradual ascend to Koto. Koto is a small village with people following Tibetan Buddhism. Overnight in Koto.

itinerary.title: Trek from Koto to Meta (3,560 m / 11,680 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: In the morning, you register your permit at the army check post as you enter the restricted area of Nar Phu Valley. Then you start your trek through the river bank of Seti Khola, where you will see one famous Dharmasala. The further trek leads you to Meta village on the Tibetan plateau. You can have a very good view of Annapurna II (7,937 m) and Lamjung Himal (6,983 m). Overnight in Meta.

itinerary.title: Trek from Meta to Phu Gaon (4,250 m / 13,944 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Today the trek descends to the beautiful village called Kyang through the suspension bridges over different streams. Then you keep walking alongside the Phu Khola on a rocky trail until you reach Phu Gaon. You can witness the grazing blue sheep along the trail. You can see the influence of Tibetan Buddhism in the traditional village of Phu as soon as you enter via the ruined fort at the entrance. Overnight in Phu.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phu valley to Nar (4,150 m / 13,615 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: After an early morning breakfast, you will head out towards Nar. Today you will be crossing two high passes—Phu Pass (5,050 m) and Nar Pass (5,400 m)—adding challenges to the trek. You will pass many streams and suspension bridges until you reach Mahendra Pul. Then pass the high suspension bridge, 80m above the gorge of Lapche River. Further trek allows you to see many Buddhist stupas on the way and then you will reach Nar. The mud houses of this aged village are given contrast with the snowy peaks of Kanguru (6,981 m) and Nemjung (7,140 m). Overnight in Nar.

itinerary.title: Trek from Nar village to Kang La passes (5,320 m / 17,454 ft) to Ngwal (3,660 m / 12,008 ft), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: Early in the morning, you will begin the trek towards Kang La Pass (5,320 m). The trail is steep and is covered in icy moraines, so you have a challenging climb ahead. The top of Kang La provides an excellent opportunity to view the Annapurna massif along with Kangla Himal Range. Then you descend on a steep trail through the moraines to enter a grassy path leading to Ngwal village. You pass a few monasteries before entering Ngwal. Overnight in Ngwal.

itinerary.title: Trek from Ngwal to Manang (3,540 m / 11,614 ft), 4-5 hours.
itinerary.html: Today’s trek slightly descends past monasteries until you reach Braga village. Visit the 900 years old Braga Gompa and then the Boozo Gompa situated by the bank of Marsayangdi River. Cross a suspension bridge above Marsayangdi River and arrive at Gangapurna Lake before entering the village of Manang. You will be accompanied by the Annapurna massive, Gangapurna (7,454 m), and other snow-capped peaks throughout the day. Overnight in Manang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Manang to Yak Kharka (4,018 m / 13,182 ft), 4-5 hours.
itinerary.html: In this day, you will head towards Yak Kharka. During this trek, the trail leads you to the village of Tengi.  Climb out of Marsayangdi valley and then the trail passes the small village called Ghunsa. You will see an old Mani wall in a pleasant meadow on your trail and finally reach Yak Kharka. Overnight in Yak Kharka.

itinerary.title: Trek from Yak Kharka to Thorung High Camp (4,925 m / 16,158 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: A 3–4-hour trek from Yak Kharka takes you to Thorung Phedi (4,450 m), following a scenic trail through high-altitude meadows surrounded by rugged mountains and snowy peaks. If conditions permit, continue uphill to Thorung High Camp (,925 m / 16,158 ft), the starting point for the next day’s crossing of the famous Thorung La Pass (5,416 m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Thorung High Camp to Muktinath (3,800 m / 12,467 ft) via Thorung La Pass (5416 meters), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: You will start the day early as you will be climbing across Thorang La Pass (5,416 m) today. Since it is one of the highest mountain passes in Nepal, which is usually frozen, the climb is quite difficult through the steep icy paths. From Thorang La, you will be able to have a breath-taking view of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri massifs. Then you will descend through pastureland to reach Muktinath, a pilgrimage site for both Hindus and Buddhists along. Overnight in Muktinath.

itinerary.title: Trek from Muktinath to Kagbeni to Jomsom (2,720 m / 8,924 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: Early in the morning, you will explore Muktinath temple and visit the Vishnu temple near the main Shiva temple. You can also take a bath in the 108 sprouts that are supposed to wash off your sins. Then you head towards Kagbeni and then Jomsom. Descend down the famous Kali Gandaki Gorge and pass Jharkot and Khingar villages. Upon reaching the windy town of Jomsom, you will get a panoramic view of high reaching peaks of Dhaulagiri (8,167 m) and Nilgiri (7,061 m).

itinerary.title: Early morning flight from Jomsom to Pokhara (820 m / 2,690 ft), 15-20 minutes.
itinerary.html: After breakfast, you will take the flight to Pokhara. The breathtaking flight provides panoramic views of Annapurna and Dhaulagiri Himalayan ranges. Explore the beauty of Pokhara and go for a boat ride in Phewa Lake. Enjoy the vibrant evening of the lakeside area. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Tourist bus drive from Pokhara to Kathmandu, 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: After an early morning breakfast, you will drive to Kathmandu. It takes around 6-7 hours. Enjoy the ride along Marshyangdi River and Trishuli River. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel. Feel free to explore the markets of the capital city. Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drop-fff to international airport.
itinerary.html: Your trip will come to an end after today’s breakfast. After your travel arrangements are made, our representative will take you to the airport in our private van around 3 hours before your flight schedule.

title: Nepal Classic Tour
summary: Popular Nepal Classic Tour starts with a bundle of tourist attraction sites of Kathmandu valley. Package also includes Short hiking, safari, rafting etc.

seo.title: Nepal Classic Tour | Nepal Tour and Trek Package | Base Camp Adventure
seo.description: Popular Nepal Classic Tour starts with a bundle of tourist attraction sites of Kathmandu valley. Package also includes Short hiking, safari, rafting etc.

overview:
Nepal Classic Tour is a perfect blend of everything that Nepal has to offer. From the mountains to the hills and the flatland, the tour is packed with exciting adventures. The tour features notable landmarks, diverse landscapes, and exceptional natural life of the most exotic destinations of Nepal and tops it off with an exposure to the rich history and culture of the country, making it just the right tour package for curious travelers.

Nepal Classic Tour is the ultimate way to explore Nepal which begins with your exploration of various UNESCO listed world heritage sites in Kathmandu valley along with a short trip to the hill station nearest to the valley. The tour quickly explores prominent sites in Kathmandu like Pashupatinath, Boudhanath, Bhaktapur Durbar Square, Patan Durbar Square, and Kathmandu Durbar Square.

Moving on to Pokhara, the tour takes you much further to Tadapani via Ghandruk village , which hosts spectacular views of Annapurna South (7,219 m) and Machhapuchhre (6,997 m). The tour also features a hike through the lush rhododendron forest of Ghorepani to reach the famous vantage point, Poon Hill (3,193 m). A mind-blowing sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri massifs along with the unique Machhapuchhre Peak (6,997 m) greet you in Poon Hill. The tour takes you back to Pokhara, from where you leave for Chitwan but only after the exciting whitewater rafting in Trishuli River. The classic rafting adventure pumps up your adrenaline and makes you feel alive. You then reach Chitwan National Park, where the sub-tropical forests and the colorful Tharu villages await you. In Chitwan National Park, you can take part in activities sun as jungle safari, elephant bathing, canoe ride, bird watching, and so on. An amazing cultural performance by the indigenous Tharu community concludes your classic tour.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kathmandu, Transfer to Hotel.
itinerary.html: Upon arrival in Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, you will be warmly welcomed and picked by our representatives who will then drop you at a hotel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu City Sightseeing.
itinerary.html: After breakfast, you will be picked from the hotel to explore the historic Bhaktapur Durbar Square, a UNESCO world heritage site. The wood and stone carvings in the many temples and monuments as well as the traditional houses of the Newars make it a pleasant sight for the eyes and also an amazing opportunity to learn the history of ancient Bhaktapur city. you will visit Patan Durbar Square where you can see Krishna Mandir, Mul Chowk, Patan Museum, and so on. You will also visit some holy shrines like Pashupatinath and Boudhanath, which hold religious values for Hindus and Buddhists respectively. Later, you will explore the vibrant area of Kathmandu Durbar Square. Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Fly from Kathmandu - Pokhara (20-minute)-Tadapani.
itinerary.html: Today you will take a flight to Pokhara, which will take about 20 minutes. As you fly, you can get amazing views of the Annapurna massif, Machhapuchhre (6,997 m), and Ganesh Himal (7,422 m) beyond the clouds. After arrival in Pokhara you will drive to Kyumi which takes about 2 hours to reach. You start the trek towards Tadapani by crossing the Ghandruk Village. Ascending along the stone steps, you will be able to get breathtaking landscapes as you walk past small villages. Upon reaching Tadapani, you will be welcomed by a stunning view of Annapurna South (7,219 m) and Machhapuchhre (6,997 m). The picturesque village is inhabited by the Gurung ethnics who are extremely warm and hospitable. Overnight in Tadapani.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tadapani - Ghorepani.
itinerary.html: Leaving the beautiful Ghandruk village, today you walk through lush rhododendron forests on flag-stone steps as you proceed towards Ghorepani. You will first make a steep ascent to reach Deurali and then descend on a forested trail to reach Ghorepani. Throughout the journey, you will be able to get enthralling views of Annapurna South (7,219 m), Hiunchuli (6,441 m), and Machhapuchhre (6,997 m). Ghorepani is situated on the foot of Poon Hill hence hosts beautiful sceneries, comprising of the mountains and the lush hills. Overnight in guesthouse in Ghorepani.

itinerary.title: Ghorepani -Poon Hill- Tikhedhunga and then jeep drive back to Pokhara.
itinerary.html: You will start your hike to Poon Hill before dawn so that you can catch the enchanting sunrise over the snowy mountains. After watching the sunrise view, you will descend to Tikhedhunga on the stone-paved trail via Ulleri. Catch the private vehicle from Nayapul and drive back to Pokhara. Enjoy the evening with live music and amazing food at one of the restaurants. Overnight at a hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara-Trishuli River Rafring- Chitwan National Park.
itinerary.html: Today you will drive towards Chitwan, but first, an exciting rafting adventure awaits you. You will go for the classic whitewater rafting in Trishuli River, which lets you experience thrilling rapids of the raging river. You can later enjoy swimming, cliff jumping, and simply soaking up the beautiful scenery. Later, you will drive to Chitwan National Park where you will stay overnight in a resort/ hotel.

itinerary.title: Full day activities in Chitwan National Park.
itinerary.html: It is a fun day today packed with the exploration of the amazing Chitwan National Park. You will go for jungle safari in a jeep, keeping a look-out for the rare animals like the one-horned rhino and Bengal tiger. Many colorful birds are seen inside the national park adding charm to the already satisfying journey. You can later go for an elephant bath and get splashed with the cold water of Rapti River by an elephant. You can also partake in the canoe ride if you want. In the evening, the indigenous Tharu community will perform their cultural stick dance, giving you a glimpse of their way of life. Overnight in Chitwan National Park.

itinerary.title: Chitwan - Kathmandu
itinerary.html: Before leaving Chitwan, you go for bird watching inside the national park, which is home to more than 500 species of birds. You then drive alongside the Trishuli River enjoying the beautiful landscapes comprised of lush hills and countryside settlements to reach Kathmandu. Back in Kathmandu, you will be transferred to the hotel for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Transfer to airport to catch onward flight.
itinerary.html: Today is the farewell day. We will drop you at the airport after breakfast and a quick group photo.

title: Nepal Cultural Tour
summary: Explore Nepal’s vibrant culture, ancient traditions, sacred sites, and rich religious heritage on an unforgettable Nepal Cultural Tour.

seo.title: Nepal Cultural Tour Package | Best Tour Agency in Nepal
seo.description: Explore Nepal’s vibrant culture, ancient traditions, sacred sites, and rich religious heritage on an unforgettable Nepal Cultural Tour.

overview:
Nepal is recognized as one of the best destination for trekking and hiking among the adventurers due to its diverse landscapes, mountains and wonderful scenery. However, Nepal is also a culturally rich country. With people from more than 100 ethnic groups and backgrounds, this country is full of numerous tradition, culture, beliefs, custom, and religion. The ancient history and architecture had also made Nepal the country of many UNESCO world heritage sites. Nepal Cultural tour open up a plethora of cultural diversities as each part of Nepal, from east to west or from north to south has its own cultural setting, tradition, region, custom, belief and language. Sacred pilgrimage sites and historical monuments further reflect richness of Nepal cultural variation.

This special tour package takes you to the lively and colorful places of Nepal where culture, religion and tradition are the parts of everyday life. This extremely popular tour starts off with a bundle of tourist attraction sites of Kathmandu valley that comprises the magnificent UNESCO World HeritageSites like Kathmandu Durbar Square, Bhaktapur Durbar Square, Pashupatinath Temple, Patan Durbar Square, Bouddhanath, Swayambhu Nath etc and finally leading to Nagarkot. In contrast to Kathmandu, Nagarkot, renowned of its sunrise and sunset views, offers you a great view of snow-topped peaks from an observation tower at the very top of the hill.

From Nagarkot, a 7 hour drive takes us to Chitwan National Park, one of the ‘World Natural Heritage Site’ of Nepal. Elephant back safari, jungle walk, jungle safari, elephant bathing and canoe ride in Rapti River are exciting activities to do there. If you are lucky enough, you may even see amazing animals like Bengal tigers, and leopard during Jungle safari. Finally, we head towards the mysterious city Pokhara. Mesmerizing panoramas of Pokhara, would definitely compel you to make a deep observation. The rare blend of snow clad peaks and snow fed lakes and rivers has helped to make the valley one of the most picturesque natural attraction. Pokhara also offers you adventurous activities like boating, paragliding, Helicopter tour, hiking, trekking etc which attracts thousands of tourists every year.

Hence, Nepal cultural tour includes a complete jungle safari tour in Chitwan National Park, Closest sunrise and sunset from Nagarkot hill, beauty and magnificence of Pokhara city and of course religions temples, shrines, historical monuments, palaces and stupas of Kathmandu city. With this tour we assure you that you will be able to gain invaluable and incomparable insights into the diverse ethnic groups, their lifestyle, social behavior, traditions, religion and belief. So, be part of this remarkable 9 day long trip with us as we have magnificent crew whose care and experience would definitely make your trip one memorable and rewarding trip of your life.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu airport and transfer to hotel.
itinerary.html: Welcome to Nepal. You will be greeted by our representatives at the airport who will then take you to the hotel. Relax and enjoy your first day in Nepal. Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Kathmandu City Tour & Sightseeing.
itinerary.html: Today you will go for a sightseeing tour to some of the UNESCO world heritage sites in Kathmandu. You will start by visiting Boudhanath, which is one of the largest stupas in the world. Then you will visit the holy temple of the Hindus i.e. Pashupatinath. Moving on, you will visit Kathmandu Durbar Square compact with its many temples and other historical monuments. To end the day tour, you will climb up to Swayambhunath, also known as the Monkey Temple, and watch Kathmandu city light up against the dark sky. Overnight at a  hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Bhaktapur, followed by a scenic drive to Nagarkot.
itinerary.html: Today you will visit another world heritage site in the valley, Bhaktapur Durbar Square. Situated in the quaint Newar village, Bhaktapur Durbar Square is a museum of primitive art and architecture that showcase in the many statues, carvings, and the temples in the premises. You can experience the traditional culture and local food of Bhaktapur city as you stroll around. Later, you will drive to Nagarkot, a hill station considered to be one of the most picturesque places in Kathmandu valley and is famous for its sunrise and sunset views over the Himalayas. Overnight in Nagarkot.

itinerary.title: Drive from Nagarkot to Chitwan National Park (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: You will wake up early today to witness a mesmerizing sunrise over the beautiful Himalayan ranges. After enjoying the sunrise view, you will drive (6 hours)  Chitwan  via a picturesque highway. As you reach Chitwan, you will experience the change in topography. The hills start to disappear and you will see plain lands. Upon arrival in Chitwan, you will be moved to Chitwan National Park. Overnight at a resort in Chitwan National Park.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Jungle Activities In Chitwan.
itinerary.html: In Chitwan National Park, you will take a jeep for your jungle safari, which allows you to spot various animals like a one-horned rhino and Bengal tiger as well as witness many colorful birds. You can also enjoy the amazing elephant bath where you can get splashed with fresh water of Rapti River in the hot temperature. Also, you can go canoeing or rest relishing the amazing ambiance of Sauraha. The local inhabitants are the Tharu people whose Stick Dance is very popular in Chitwan for the exhibition of their culture, so you are going to thoroughly enjoy the performance in the evening. Overnight at a resort in Chitwan National Park.

itinerary.title: Drive from Chitwan to Pokhara (4-5 hours).
itinerary.html: Leaving Chitwan Natipnal Park, you head towards the natural paradise i.e. Pokhara. The highway takes you back to the mid-hills and leads you on to the lake city with a view of Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) arising in the backdrop. After arriving in Pokhara, you can spend a relaxing time around the lakeside area and enjoy the live music and amazing food in the restaurants situated in Lakeside, Pokhara. Overnight at a hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Pokhara City Tour & Sightseeing.
itinerary.html: You will start the day in Pokhara with early morning trip to Sarangkot Hill station for the stunning sunrise view of the Annapurna massif and Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) along with a bird’s eye view of Pokhara city and Phewa Lake. After sarangkot we come back to hotel for the breakfast and then do boat trip in Phewa Lake, you can also visit Tal Barahi Temple situated amid the lake on a small island then after crossing lake by the same boat we do one hour's beautiful hiking to World Peace Stupa. You will then be picked up at Stupa and then visit Davi's fall and Gupteshor Cave. You can then take a cycle and explore the city as you like. Overnight at a 3-star hotel in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Drive back from Pokhara to Kathmandu (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: Today you will return to Kathmandu ( to avoid road trip, you have option to fly to Kathmandu by paying extra flight fare ). Upon reaching Kathmandu, feel free to stroll around the places of Kathmandu, Thamel, Asan Bazar (local market) . Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Transfer to the International Airport for your onward journey.
itinerary.html: After breakfast, rest of day is at leisure until we pick you up at the hotel and then transfer to international airport to fly back home.

title: Nepal Family Tour Package
summary: Nepal Family Tour package comes with a complete tour activities for kids and families. Package includes sightseeing, Jungle Safari and Hiking.

seo.title: Nepal Family Tour Package | Cost | Itinerary
seo.description: Nepal Family Tour package comes with a complete tour activities for kids and families. Package includes sightseeing, Jungle Safari and Hiking.

overview:
Nepal is a paradise for people who love to be among nature and culture. This country is home to eight highest mountains of the world, heavenly landscapes, and more than a hundred different cultures and traditions. These specialties make Nepal the ideal place for a family vacation. You can witness some of the world's rarest flora and fauna, heart melting sceneries, snow-capped mountains peaks, and unique customs during your family tour in Nepal.It is for that reason, we offer Nepal family tour with your kids, different closes family and companions joining on vacation.

Nepal Family Tour Package starts with visiting Kathmandu, capital city of Nepal, city of sanctuary and city of living Goddess Kumari. The old part of the city, with restricted medieval boulevards and stunning little holy places presents you pagoda-roofed sanctuaries, stone, models, old monasteries and noteworthy landmarks. After visiting old monasteries and UNESCO listed site in Kathmandu, we drive you to Chitwan national park which is first and prestigious national park that offers Elephant Riding Jungle strolling, Jeep Drive to see birds and endangered animals, Canoe ride in Rapti River, Tharu social appear and many more.

After having adventure at Chitwan, we finally head Australian Camp crossing through Pokhara which is most wonderful mountain views in the north. And the next day we go to Pokhara, the real fascination of Pokhara are Phewa Lake, Begnas Lake, Mahendra Cave, Seti River Gorge, Barahi Temple, Mountain Museum, World Peace Pagoda and Sarangkot. Pokhara is additionally renowned for experience outside exercises like paragliding, avia flights, drifting, mountain biking etc.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Tribhuwan International Airport, Kathmandu, and then you will be transferred to your hotel.
itinerary.html: Arrival in Kathmandu airport airport, you will be greeted by one of our representatives who will then take you to the hotel. Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Kathmandu, Patan, Bhaktapur City Tour & Sightseeing (7-8 hours)
itinerary.html: After having a little breakfast, you will visit the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of the Kathmandu valley. You will visit Pashupatinath, Boudhanath, Bhaktapur Durbar Squire, Patan Durbar Squire.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Chitwan National Park (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: Today you will drive to Chitwan National Park following a picturesque black-topped highway. As you fly towards Chitwan, you will experience the change in landscape and temperature. Chitwan lies in the Terai region of Nepal, so the climate is hot and humid. After your arrival in Chitwan, you will be transferred to the hotel. After having some rest, you can roam around the nearby Tharu village adorned with their colorful houses. Overnight in Chitwan National Park.

itinerary.title: Full-Day jungle activities in Chitwan National Park (6-7 hours).
itinerary.html: Today will be a fun day in Chitwan. You can enjoy the amazing jungle safari as well as an elephant bath, where you can get splashed with fresh water in the hot temperature. Jungle safari and jungle walk allow you to see numerous animals such as one-horned rhino, tiger, crocodiles, deer, and so on in their natural settings along with varieties of floras. Canoeing is also the best idea to see a crocodile from near. After enjoying your time with nature, you can meet the local people of this place. The indigenous Tharu dance is very popular in Chitwan as their dance reflects their rich and ancient culture. Overnight in Chitwan National Park.

itinerary.title: Drive from Chitwan to Kande via Pokhara, followed by a scenic trek to Australian Camp (6-7 hours).
itinerary.html: After 3-4 hours’ drive from Chitwan to Pokhara, we continue another an hour drive to Kande and then start a small hike to Australian Camp. The Australian Camp (1,890 m) is one of the most popular beautiful Mountain hill close to Pokhara. It is very easy small day hike, so attractive for its sunrise and sunset, offer gorgeous views over the valleys and stunning views of the Annapurna Himalayas range. This trip can be done all year round and is also very suitable for people without any hiking experience and people of all ages. The magnificence view of all Annapurna range is the main attraction of this hill station. From sunrise to sunset the colors will keep on changing offering the most incredible views. This is an hour’s hike through dense forests, along the hillsides and through mountain villages. From Australian Camp we can see Annapurna I (8,091 m), Annapurna South (7,219 m) Hiunchuli (6,434 m), Fishtail (6,997 m), Annapurna II (7,937 m), Annapurna III (7,555 m), Annapurna IV (7,525 m), Lamjung Himal (6,983 m) and many other beautiful snow-capped mountains

itinerary.title: Trek from Australian Camp to Dhampus, then drive to Pokhara (4-5 hours).
itinerary.html: After breakfast, begin your scenic trek from Australian Camp to Dhampus, enjoying beautiful views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges along the way. The trail passes through peaceful forests, traditional villages, and terraced farmland, offering a wonderful glimpse of rural Nepalese life. Upon reaching Dhampus. From Dhampus, continue by road with a scenic drive to Pokhara. On the way we stop at Tibetan refugee camp. Check in at hotel and later begin tour around Phewa lake with boating reaching the temple called Tal Barahi situated on an island in the middle of Phewa Lake. The reflection of Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) on the surface of the lake makes the sight even more ravishing. Later, explore the mysterious Davis Falls. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Pokhara city tour and Sightseeing (6-7 hours).
itinerary.html: Pokhara valley is also called Himalayan Shangri-La from where you can see mountains like Mt. Mt. Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) and the Annapurna Range. The most interesting part of Pokhara is boating in Phewa Lake and visiting Tal Barahi Temple, situated on an island in the middle of Phewa Lake. Explore fascinating places such as Davis Falls, Mahendra Cave, Chamero (Bat) Cave, Seti River George, and World Peace Pagoda. Adventurous activities like boating, hiking, paragliding, helicopter tour to Annapurna Base Camp, and bungee jump can be done. Also, enjoy cycling around the streets of Pokhara. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara to Kathmandu, visit Kathmandu Durbar Square and Swyambhunath. (8-9 hours).
itinerary.html: You drive back to Kathmandu and visit Swyambhunath and Kathmandu Durbar Square en route to your hotel. This ancient palace square, listed under UNESCO's world heritage sites, gives you a glimpse of the rich art, culture, and architecture of the ancient rulers of Kathmandu. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Transfer to the International Airport for your onward journey.
itinerary.html: Today, we will transfer you to the international airport for your scheduled departure to your next destination.

title: Nepal Heritage Tour
summary: 10 Days of Nepal Heritage Tour covers all of Nepal's Heritage Sites recognized by the UNESCO as the World Heritage Site. We make a visit to medieval cities.

seo.title: Nepal Heritage Tour | Kathmandu | Lumbini | Chitwan | Pokhara
seo.description: 10 Days of Nepal Heritage Tour covers all of Nepal's Heritage Sites recognized by the UNESCO as the World Heritage Site. We make a visit to medieval cities.

overview:
UNESCO has declared 10 World Heritage Sites, 7 inside Kathmandu Valley & 3 outside; Lumbini including Kathmandu Valley are Cultual Hertiage & Chitwan National Park & Sagarmatha National Parkas Natural Heritage Nepal Heritage Tour covers all of Nepal’s Heritage Sites recognized by the UNESCO as the World Heritage Site.

They are some of Kathmandu’s Heritage Sites -Kathmanu Durbar Square, Pashupatinath, Swayambhu, Boudhanath. We make a visit to the two medieval cities famous for their arts and architectures – Patan and Bhaktapur. Then we drive to Chitwan Jungle and discover why the Chitwan National Parkholds an important place in preserving the wild lives that are rapidly getting extinct from this planet and therefore recognized by the UNESCO as a World Heritage Site.

From Chitwan, we drive further south-west to Buddha’s birthplace of Lumbini – also a World Heritage Site of the world civilization. After exploring Lumbini, we head to the Lake City of Pokhara – one of world’s most beautiful valleys. Spending another full day in exploring the natural and cultural grandeur of Pokhara,and back to Kathmandu. We finish Nepal Heritage Tour with an hour’s superb mountain flight over the whole Himalayan Range including the Mt. Everest and as well as Kathmandu city tour.

itinerary.title: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, you will be welcomed by our representative and comfortably transferred to your hotel in Kathmandu.
itinerary.html: Upon arrival in Kathmandu, you will be kindly welcomed by our team, and later you will be taken to your hotel. Feel free to enjoy your day here in Kathmandu. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Full-day Kathmandu, Bhaktapur and patan city Sightseeing (6-7 hours)
itinerary.html: After breakfast, start to visit Kathmandu city and Bhaktapur Durbar Squire, Patan Durbar Squire and Swyambhunath. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Chitwan National Park (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: Travel overland from Kathmandu to Chitwan National Park. Once the night falls down, we entertain you with cultural performances including bonfire before getting in bed.

itinerary.title: Full-day activities in Chitwan National Park (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: Breakfast, the next, you get a full day safari activities in Chitwan national Park. We experience you a lots of Safari activities; jungle walks, canoeing and so forth, if you are lucky, you will see many amazing creatures that you spend most time to looking for; Rhinoceroses, Chitwan’s royal Bengal tigers, leopards, monkeys, Crocodiles many types of deer and reptiles. Check your camera gear – preferably with a telephoto lens and you will not miss any shots. Stay overnight in Chitwan.

itinerary.title: Drive from Chitwan to Lumbini (3-4 hours).
itinerary.html:
After 2 nights in Chitwan we travel overland to Lumbini, the birthplace of Lord Buddha, where has been revered as the place of holy pilgrimage. Lumbini has been included as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO. 

Upon arrival Lumbini, we transfer you to the hotel, check-in and then we go walking through the Sacred Lumbini Garden where the Buddha was born converges on the Ashoka pillar, visit the Maya Devi Temple with its bas-relief sculpture depicting Maya Devi holding on with her right hand to a branch of pipal tree and giving birth to the infant Buddha who stand up on a lotus pedestal.

itinerary.title: Drive from Lumbini to Pokhara (6-7 hours).
itinerary.html: Today you head towards Pokhara leaving Lumbini and its amazing monasteries behind. The highway provides you with amazing landscapes that zoom off as you get closer to your destination. Upon arrival in Pokhara, you will have plenty of time to stroll around the lakeside area. Overnight  in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Full-day Pokhara city Sightseeing (6-7 hours).
itinerary.html: Today early morning we go to Sarangkot view point for the bird eye view of the Himalayas. It is an amazing place with the spectacular panorama of the Annapurna, Machhapuchhre/ Fishtail and other many mountains. Pokhara is also packed with many natural as well as cultural wonders along with various adventure sports, which makes you feel that one day is not enough time to explore this extremely gorgeous lake city. You can go for boating in Phewa Lake, in the middle of which stands Tal Barahi Temple on a small island. You can also visit the delightful Davis Falls and the sacred Gupteswor Cave. In Pokhara, you will never run out of things to do. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Fly from Pokhara to Kathmandu (approximately 25 minutes), followed by a sightseeing tour of Kathmandu City (3-4 hours).
itinerary.html: We will take a morning flight to Kathmandu. After arrival in Kathmadu you go again on a guided tour to different most ancient and divine attractions in Kathmandu. Some of these milestones are listed under UNESCO world heritage sites including the historic Kathmandu Durbar Square, the Hindu temple of Pashupatinath, and the Buddhist shrines of and Boudhanath. Visiting these places will allow you to understand the cultural and architectural richness of Kathmandu. Overnight in Kathmandu.

itinerary.html: After such an amazing trip, we bid you goodbye hoping to see you again. Our representative will transfer you to the airport approximately three hours before your scheduled flight departure.

title: Nepal Historical Tours
summary: Nepal Historical Tours introduce you to some of the historical landmarks of Nepal. The tour explore old temples and also to know about local culture.

seo.title: Nepal Historical Tours | Cultural Heritage Tours in Nepal
seo.description: Nepal Historical Tours introduce you to some of the historical landmarks of Nepal. The tour explore old temples and also to know about local culture.

overview:
Nepal, a small mountainous country is one of the very few countries that is blessed with natural beauties and unique cultural heritages. This country is recognized worldwide for its high mountains, one of a kind social legacy, aesthetic landmarks and extraordinary natural life. Along with that, Nepal has a long history about its rich tradition and culture, which still remains unique for foreign and domestic tourists and attracts lots of tourists every year. So, if you are someone who wants to explore historic sites, lifestyle, culture and tradition of Nepal, then Nepal Historical Tours is the right option for you.

There are many places in Nepal, which genuinely holds an enormous degree of historic importance. Trip so such places ensures you get familiar with the major events occurred in the past in these historic areas. So, Nepal Historic Tours is the ultimate way to explore these various historic sites of Nepal. Furthermore, it provides the traveler with the rich spiritual background about the country while visiting the nation’s capital and beyond.

History of Nepal can be understood with the visit of Historic Kathmandu valley. It is believed that the history of the valley began when the Buddhist saint Manjushree slashed a passage through the surrounding hill of the valley to drain out the water to make it civilised. Along with that, there are many temples, monastery and monuments that were built in the Malla Dynesty which are worth visiting. Among the many temples, Pashupati nath temple is the most important one. There are many sights in Kathmandu which were listed in world heritage sites like Bhaktaput durbar square, Patan durbar square, Changu Narayan temple, Swayambunath etc. Hence, a tour to Kathmandu valley would definitely be a charming trip of your Nepal travel.

Gorkha is yet another place carrying great historic importance. Before Nepal was unified, it was divided in many states like Baise and Choubise and Gorkha was the most powerful state among them. It was the king of Gorkha, King Prithvi Narayan Shah who unified the Kingdom of Nepal during the eighteenth century. In Gorkha you can visit the great Gorkha palace which is the most important historic site in Nepal.

The historic tour is definitely incomplete without visiting Lumbini. Also called ‘The Lovely One’, Lumbini is the birthplace of Gautam Buddha, ‘The Light of Asia’. This place is very famous for Maya Devi Temple. It is believed that the present temple has been built at the exact place where queen Maya Devi gave birth to Lord Buddha. Another important structure is Ashoka pillar. Apart from that Lumini has various other stupas and monasteries that carry historic importance.

All in all, our Nepal Historical Tours is dedicated to introduce you to some of the historical landmarks of Nepal. This carefully designed tour offers you to explore centuries old temples, stupas, monasteries, monuments and also advance to know about the local culture festivals and several ethnic groups.

So visit Kathmandu valley, historic durbar square, great Gorkha Palace. Get to Lumnini to explore Lord Buddha’s Birthplace. Interact with locals to know their cultures and traditions. And make this tour a classic one.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, followed by a private transfer to your hotel in Kathmandu.
itinerary.html: Upon your arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, our representative will pick you up and escort you to the hotel. Overnight stay at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Full-day Patan and Kathmandu city tour and sightseeing (6-7 hours).
itinerary.html: Today we start our tour from Monkey Temple / Swayambhunath, and explore the ancient palace and temples of Kathmandu Durbar Square. Later, you will explore Patan Durbar Square and visit the museum situated in the Durbar Square premises. Both Kathmandu and Patan Durbar Squares boast of the ancient history and architecture of the former rulers of the respective cities. These palace squares also showcase the extraordinary skills of the ancient artists with the many wood and stone carving found in the many temples of the respective areas. Overnight stay in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Full-day Bhaktapur City, Changunarayan Temple, Pashupatinath and Boudhanath sightseeing (7-8 hours).
itinerary.html: Today we first visit the oldest temple of Changunarayan. The temple contains some of the most exemplary wood carvings in the country.  And on your way back, you will visit the ancient Newar town of Bhaktapur. Walking through the narrow alleys with traditional houses on each side, you will make your way towards Bhaktapur Durbar Square, where you can observe the rich art and architecture of the Newar community. Afterward, you will visit the Hindu temple of Pashupatinath and the Buddhist shrine of Boudhanath before heading back to the hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Drive to Lumbini and visit Sacred Lumbini Garden, the Ashoka pillar, Maya Devi Temple (7-8 hours).
itinerary.html: Today, you’ll take an approximately 8-hour long drive to the peaceful land of Lumbini. Lumbini is the birthplace of Gautama Buddha hence consists of many monasteries made by various countries. Upon your arrival in Lumbini, you will visit the sacred garden of Lumbini along with the Ashoka Pillar and Maya Devi Temple. Maya Devi Temple is believed to be the spot where Maya Devi gave birth to Siddhartha Gautama, and as a proof, the temple houses the ruins of an ancient palace. Overnight in Lumbini.

itinerary.title: Visit Tilaurakot and visit Kapilvastu Museum (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: Today you will explore the Lumbini vicinity while taking in the peaceful environ of the area. You will visit the various monasteries in Lumbini and also visit the World Peace Stupa. Afterward, you will drive 27km south of Lumbini to visit Tilaurakot, where you can see the ruins of the ancient palace of King Suddodhan, the father of Prince Siddhartha Gautama. Tilaurakot is the place where Gautama Buddha spent his formative years as a Shakya Prince. In the evening, you will visit the Kapilvastu Museum, where you can find many archaeological monuments. After the exploration, drive back to Lumbini for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Drive from Lumbini to Gorkha (4-5 hours).
itinerary.html: Leaving Lumbini, you will head to yet another historical city today. You will start the drive to Gorkha early just in case there is traffic en route. Enjoying the amazing countryside views along the highway, you reach Gorkha. Gorkha is a beautiful city in the mid-hills which is also the birthplace of King Prithvi Narayan Shah who started the unification process of Nepal. Overnight in Gorkha.

itinerary.title: Explore Gorkha Durbar and Gorak Nath Temple, followed by a scenic drive to Kathmandu (4-5 hours).
itinerary.html: Gorkha Durbar is one of the major attractions here in Gorkha. So, you will drive to the base of the palace and then start hiking on stone steps to reach the ancient palace of Gorkha, which hosts amazing views of Gorkha city as well as the surrounding green landscape. You will later visit the Gorak Nath Temple and explore the market of Gorkha city. After exploring Gorkha,  drive back to Kathmandu. Overnight at a hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Transfer to the International Airport for your onward journey.
itinerary.html: Your tour comes to an end today. Our representative will drive you to the airport to connect you to your scheduled flight.

title: Nepal Jungle Safari Tours
summary: Nepal Jungle Safari Tours gives chance to adventure seekers to explore the unexplored trails and un-spoilt natural horizons of the forests.

seo.title: Nepal Jungle Safari Tours | Bardia and Chitwan National Park cost
seo.description: Nepal Jungle Safari Tours gives chance to adventure seekers to explore the unexplored trails and un-spoilt natural horizons of the forests.

overview:
A paradise for adventure thrillers searching for landscape diversity and clam, Nepal is one of the most popular destinations for traveler that offer enthralling and adventurous activities; Jungle safari being the one. For those who wish to experience the natural environment at its best there is no better alternative than Nepal Jungle Safari Tours. It is one of the most amazing trips in Nepal as it is exceptionally rich in biodiversity and natural environment and gives chance to adventure seekers to explore the unexplored trails and un-spoilt natural horizons of the forests.

The southern belt of Nepal, also known as Terai, is covered with dense subtropical forest. Here you can find some of the most exciting safari destinations in the world as it is home to nine national parks, four wildlife reserves and three conservation areas, occupying 16 percent of Nepal’s total geographical area. These national parks and wildlife reserves are full of wildlife such as swamp deer, musk deer, black deer, blue bull, the Royal Bengal Tiger, gharial, marsh mugger crocodile and the last of a breed of Asiatic wild buffalo. Parks and reserve are also rich in bird species with a variety of babbles and orioles, peacocks, koels and drongos etc. Exploring this wide variety of wildlife in their natural habitat via a jeep or an elephant or even on a horse drive would definitely a life time experience. As per the statistics, it is demonstrated that Nepal is the home of about 2 percent of the aggregate blooming plants on the planet, and more than 850 types of the world’s birds. Essentially, it is home to almost 500 types of butterflies, more than 600 indigenous plants and about 320 types of extraordinary orchids. These diversities must be investigated through having Jungle safari. You can have maybe a couple day trek through the rich woodland, or can wander around on elephant back or jeep ride.

The best and most famous place for the jungle safari in Nepal are Chitwan National Park and Bardia National Park offering excellent opportunity to see Royal Bengal Tigers, one horned Rhino, crocodile and thrilling wilderness experience. Ride on an elephant’s back or on four wheeler, it will lead you to path where you can discover some rare wildlife in their natural habitats. Apart from scenic views of the rarest and endangered wild lives on earth, most jungle safari consists of canoe rides on the Jungle’s river, nature walks, birds watching and quick tours around the villages to discover unique culture and tradition which are sure to add more colors to your trip. Thus, Nepal's Jungle Safari Tour is one the great ways to relax and have fun during your holidays with your loved ones or your family. We, base camp adventure, are always there to help you with you stay. With our experienced, well trained, caring and friendly crew members you are sure to have one memorable and rewarding trip of your life time. So, feel blessed with amazing wildlife and flora and fauna filled exploration that comes once in a life time.

reviews.author: mark_Eccl-Truro, United Kingdom
reviews.body: Ive just returned from a trek to Base Camp and a 3 day safari to Chitwan. Having been planning this trip for 2 years, 21 of us from UK made the trip. There was a large number of questions from our group due to there being 21 of us. Shree (owner of Base Camp Adventure) was always available with answers and ensured any requests we had were met with no fuss. All arrangements were made for us and there was no issues while in Nepal. We had 3 excellent guides who were both knowledgeable about the area as well as being fully aware of all our medical needs. The organisation and planning done for our trip made it a smooth one and ensured that everyones memories were about the positive side of the trek. There were no surprises for us and all accommodation was as described (in most cases it was actually better than expected) and the food was varied. I would have no hesitation in highly recommending Base Camp Adventure to anyone. They have been a very reliable trekking company and extremely honest in there descriptions of what they can deliver (and deliver they do).

title: Nepal Luxury Tour Package
summary: Nepal is an ideal place for luxury tour packages. We provide the best luxury tour packages at best and affordable price with high quality service.

seo.title: Nepal Luxury Tour Package - Base Camp Adventure Tours
seo.description: Nepal is an ideal place for luxury tour packages. We provide the best luxury tour packages at best and affordable price with high quality service.

overview:
Nepal is the land of world's highest mountains, wonderful natural sceneries, and ancient culture and history which makes the country an ideal destination for luxury travelers. For those who want to spent little more budget on high quality service on accommodation and transport, our luxury tour package is not only an opportunity to experience Nepal but also feel travel comfort.

The 9 days Nepal Luxury Tour package takes you to some of the prominent places of the three major tourist centers of Nepal: Kathmandu, Chitwan, and Pokhara. No luxury trip in Nepal is complete without seeing the mountains closely, so Nepal Luxury Tour Package starts with an extravagant mountain flight over the high Himalayas, including the world's highest peak- Everest (8,848 m). The tour then takes you to the UNESCO listed world heritage sites in Kathmandu, where you can explore the ancient history and culture of the age-old valley. A visit to Pashupatinath temple, Boudhanath stupa, and Kathmandu Durbar Square will give you glimpses of the various culture of Kathmandu Valley.

Afterward, as you visit the first national park of Nepal, Chitwan National Park, you come in contact with the diverse flora and fauna that Nepal has to flaunt. Fun activities like jungle safari, elephant bathing, bird watching, and canoeing keep you busy in Chitwan. Similarly, the cultural Tharu dance and the walk to their colorful village allow you to get acquainted with their simple lifestyle.

The last destination of the trip, Pokhara, serves as one of the most popular tourist destinations, and for newlywed, the place resonates romance in its air. The breathtaking sunrise view over the snow-capped mountains seen from the top of Sarangkot fill your heart with calmness, but if you're feeling adventurous, you can partake in adventure sports like paragliding, bungee jumping, and zip lining. Further on, boating on the Phewa Lake under the shadow of Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) and a visit to some of the noted places of Pokhara like Davis Falls and World Peace Stupa. On the final day you will fly to Kathmandu and at the end of your trip  walk around Thamel street for the last minute shopping in the vibrant shops in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Arrive at Tribhuwan International Airport (TIA) Kathmandu and than transfer to hotel.
itinerary.html: After your arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, our airport representative will pick you up and transfer you to the hotel. Overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Early morning mountain flight, followed by sightseeing in Kathmandu (7-8 hours).
itinerary.html: Today you take an early morning mountain flight which gives you a supreme aerial view of the Himalayas, enchanting you with the range of the highest peaks in the world including Mt Everest (8,848 m). After the mountain flight, you head on to a guided tour to four of the seven UNESCO world heritage sites in Kathmandu. You start with visiting Pashupatinath temple, which is a sacred temple of Hindu devotee. Then you will visit the Buddhist shrine of Boudhanath, one of the largest stupas in Asia. Later on, you will visit the famous Kathmandu Durbar Square and explore its many temples and monuments. Enjoy the ambiance of the ancient palace square before driving back to the hotel. Overnight at the hotel in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Morning flight from Kathmandu to Chitwan (approximately 20 minutes).
itinerary.html: After breakfast we will transfer you to fly to Chitwan. It is just 20 minutes flight. Pick up from airport and transfer to our hotel in Chitwan. After reaching the hotel and getting refreshed, you will go for a guided village tour and walk on the banks of Rapti River to watch the pleasant sunset view against the sub-tropical jungle. In the evening, you will meet the local people of this place known as Tharu. They will organize dinner with the cultural program for you. This is the best chance to know about their culture and tradition. Also, they perform so well that it can make you get up and dance with them. Overnight in Chitwan.

itinerary.title: Full-day jungle activities in Chitwan National park (5-6 hours)
itinerary.html: The Chitwan National Park has been acknowledged by the UNESCO as a world heritage site. After visiting here, anyone will learn why the National Park holds a significant place in conserving the wild lives that are speedily getting vanished from this planet. The park is home to rhinoceros, tigers, leopards, wild bison, and Gharial. Numerous activities can be done here, such as jungle safari, nature walk, bird watching, elephant bathing, and canoe ride. You will have the best time with nature and wildlife here in Chitwan. Overnight in Chitwan.

itinerary.title: Fly from Chitwan to Pokhara, drive to Kande, and trek to Australian Camp (5-6 hours).
itinerary.html: After 15 minutes flight from Chitwan to Pokhara, we pick you up at the airport and then drive 45 minutes to Kande for a small but beautiful hike to Australian Camp. The Australian Camp (1,890 m) is one of the most popular beautiful Mountain hill close to Pokhara. It is very easy small day hike, so attractive for its sunrise and sunset, offer gorgeous views over the valleys and stunning views of the Annapurna Himalayas range. This trip can be done all year round and is also very suitable for people without any hiking experience and people of all ages. The magnificence view of all Annapurna range is the main attraction of this hill station. From sunrise to sunset the colors will keep on changing offering the most incredible views. This is an hour’s hike through dense forests, along the hillsides and through mountain villages. From Australian Camp we can see Annapurna I (8,091 m), Annapurna South (7,219 m) Hiunchuli (6,434 m), Fishtail (6,997 m), Annapurna II (7,937 m), Annapurna III (7,555 m), Annapurna IV (7,525 m), Lamjung Himal (6,983 m) and many other beautiful snow-capped mountains

itinerary.title: Trek from Australian Camp to Dhampus, followed by a drive to Pokhara (3-4 hours).
itinerary.html: Start your day with a spectacular sunrise over the Annapurna range before beginning your trek to Dhampus. From Dhampus, drive back to Pokhara, stopping en route at the Tibetan Refugee Camp. After checking in at your hotel, enjoy a relaxing boat ride on Phewa Lake and visit Tal Barahi Temple, situated on an island in the middle of the lake. The reflection of Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) on the tranquil waters of Phewa Lake creates a truly breathtaking view. Later, visit the fascinating Davis Falls before returning to your hotel. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Pokhara city tour and Sightseeing (5-6 hours)
itinerary.html: Pokhara valley is also called Himalayan Shangri-La from where you can see mountains like Mt. Mt. Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) and the Annapurna Range. The most interesting part of Pokhara is boating in Phewa Lake and World Peace Pagoda. Adventurous activities like boating, hiking, paragliding, helicopter tour to Annapurna Base Camp, and bungee jump can be done. Also, can enjoy cycling around the Phewa lake of Pokhara. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Fly from Pokhara to Kathmandu.
itinerary.html: Morning flight to Kathmandu, visit Bhaktapur Durbar Squire, Patan Durbar Squire and then hotel check-in. In the evening join for Nepalese dinner with cultural Dance. Overnight at Hotel.

itinerary.html: Today, we will transfer you to the international airport for your scheduled departure to your next destination.

title: Paldor Peak Climbing
summary: Paldor Peak Climbing lets you reach heights upto 5896m. We have designed Paldor Peak Trek for 17 days but it can be adjusted as per trekkers demand.

seo.title: Paldor Peak Climbing | 17 Days Paldor Peak Itinerary
seo.description: Paldor Peak Climbing lets you reach heights upto 5896m. We have designed Paldor Peak Trek for 17 days but it can be adjusted as per trekkers demand.

overview:
Paldor lies at the south-east end of Ganesh Himal marking the junction of the Tiru and Karpu Dandas at the head of the Mailung Khola, a tributary of the Trishuli Gandaki river. On a clear day the Ganesh Himal, with the icy fangs of Pabil (7,101 m), Logsang Karpo (7,150 m), Ganesh I (7,406 m) and Ganesh V (6,950 m) can be seen forming an imposing backdrop to the north-west of Kathmandu.

Into this region you would be welcomed by tranquil lakes, tremendous waterfall along the trail and majority of Tamang people and great Himalayan landscapes. This peak was first climbed by Bill Tilman, Peter Lloyd, Tenzing Sherpa and Da Namgyal during the monsoon of 1949 by the North-East Ridge, although it must be said that it is difficult to fit Tilman’s description to the actual route.

We have designed Paldor Peak CLimbing for 17 days but the itinerary can be adjusted as per trekkers demand and time schedule.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Syabrubesi which takes about nine hours.
itinerary.html: You head north out of Kathmandu driving through scenic foothills and ridgeline vistas to Syabrubesi passing through Dhunche. While passing along the road at the bank of Trishuli river you catch a glimpse of Ganesh Himal, terraces and green hills. As you pass through Dhunche you feel as if you are heading towards deep land. At the same time, you notice that the road is still under construction.

itinerary.title: Trek from Syabrubesi to Gatlang (2238m.) via Goljung which takes about six hours.
itinerary.html: While trekking you experience of the Tamang culture. You can see scenery from view point. This day you walk through village. The cultural show at Goljung and Gatlang makes your trekking a memorable one. Gatlang set high on a hillside among terraced fields is a Tamang settlement. One can visit a Tamang monastery and beautiful Parvatikunda Lake at Gatlang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Gatlang to Yuri Kharka (3390m.) which takes about five hours.
itinerary.html: You trek ascent path all the way to Yuri Kharka passing through forests of fir, juniper, rhododendron and local vegetation. During the monsoon local people bring their domestic animals for grazing in Yuri Kharka.

itinerary.title: Trek from Yuri Kharka to Somdang (3,270m.) via Khurpudanda pass (3,620m) which takes about five hours.
itinerary.html: Till Khurpudanda pass the trail moves uphill and you begin to follow descent path to reach Somdang. From the view point of Khurpudanda pass you can enjoy the spectacular views of Paldor, Langtang, Ganesh Himal, Pangsang La and many more. En route you pass forests. At Somdang you can observe zinc mines.

itinerary.title: Trek from Somdang to Jasta Khani (3700m.) which takes about five hours.
itinerary.html: This day you trek gradual ascent path passing forests until you reach Paigutang Kharka. Now, the trail goes steep up to Jasta Khani. On the way you cross rocky path covered by juniper. There is a zinc mine at Jasta Khani.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jasta Khani to Paldor Base Camp (4,280m) which takes about five hours.
itinerary.html: The path is ascent along the rocky glacier trail. While walking, you can enjoy the views of Paldor and rock hills around you.

itinerary.title: Rest day at Base camp for acclimatization.
itinerary.html: This is an acclimatization day for the preparation of Paldor summit.

itinerary.title: Climb from Paldor base camp to High camp which takes about five hours.
itinerary.html: The path moves through rocky glacier. The views of Paldor East and Paldor West completely mesmerize you. Moreover you can enjoy the views of rocky hills and green hills around you.

itinerary.title: Rest day at High camp for acclimatization.
itinerary.html: This is another acclimatization day for Paldor summit.

itinerary.title: Summit Paldor Peak (5,896m) and come back to Base Camp which takes about nine hours.
itinerary.html: At the summit of Paldor you will be speechless by the panoramic views of Ganesh Himal, Shisapangma, Langtang Lirung, Ganesh I, II, III, Manaslu and views of Tibet mountains.

itinerary.title: Trek from Base camp to Somdang which takes about seven hours.
itinerary.html: Now you walk straight downhill all the way to Paigutang Kharka and then the trail moves along gradual descent path to Somdang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Somdang to Narchet Kharka (3800m.) which takes about seven hours.
itinerary.html: To reach Narchet Kharka you trek gradual ascent path passing through forests and green hills. The views you can enjoy are of Ganesh Himal, Manaslu, Langtang Lirung and many other unnamed mountains and peaks.

itinerary.title: Trek from Narchet Kharka to Sertung that takes about seven hours.
itinerary.html: The trail you follow is quite descent at first and then it climbs up for some distance. En route, you cross forests covered with bamboo, pine, rhododendron and waterfalls. Tipling is the first village you encounter on this route. It is a big Tamang village which is rich in mixed culture and has chorten and church. The houses are made of wood, tin and stones. People living here have their distinct life style and they are involved in making goods from bamboo sticks. You can see farming terraces where farmers grow potatoes, wheat, barley, buck wheat, maize and green vegetables. Now, you have to climb down steeply until you cross a suspension bridge over Gorkhen Khola (stream). After you cross, the trails go uphill up to Sertung. It is also a Gurung village. People of this area welcome the trekkers with their local culture.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sertung to Jharlang which takes approximately eight hours.
itinerary.html: The early part of your trail is gently up until you arrive at small ridge. From here, you can enjoy spectacular view of Ganesh Himal , farming terraces, waterfall and several villages at a distance. Now, you climb down the ridge and cross farming terraces and local villages. After you take lunch at Borang, your trails turn downhill and uphill respectively to Jharlang. It can be best described as Tamang village with its mixed culture.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jharlang to Darkha which takes about seven hours.
itinerary.html: Crossing landslide nearby Jharlang, you begin your trek through ascent path with views of Ganesh Himal, Manaslu, jungle, waterfall, farming terraces and villages. Darkha is the first Brahmin village on this trek. From here you can enjoy the view of Aankhu stream at some distance.

itinerary.title: Trek from Darkhu to Khahare Bazaar that takes about seven hours.
itinerary.html: The early part of your trek is descent up to Darkha phedi and your route moves along the river bank until you reach Khahare. There is a big market at Khahare Bazaar with lodges, tea shops, big school and other important buildings. This place is famous for magnificent views of farming terraces.

itinerary.title: Drive from Khahare Bazaar to Kathmandu by bus which takes approximately eight hours.
itinerary.html: The road till Dhadingbesi moves through unpaved road and then you drive along the well paved road until you reach Kathmandu. It can be best defined as scenic journey due to the beautiful views of rivers, hills, terraces, forests and villages.

title: Panchase Trekking
summary: Panchase Trek is one of the famous tourist destination. This trek is a spectacular short trek with just four days of itinerary

seo.title: Panchase Trek | Short and easy trek itinerary from Pokhara
seo.description: Panchase Trek is one of the famous tourist destination. This trek is a spectacular short trek with just four days of itinerary

overview:
Panchase Trek is one the most famous, easy, and relaxing trekking trails in the Annapurna region in western Nepal. Panchase, being the highest hill in the region, offers a spectacular view of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri massifs along with other snowy peaks which appear even more majestic with the sunrise and sunset colors that transform the view of the mountains. The trek also features a cultural exploration of the Gurung ethnics that dominate the Annapurna region. This trek is suitable for all age groups as the trail is easy and simple.

Panchase Trek is a short trek taking you to the outskirts of Pokhara, allowing you to be in the lap of nature. Starting from Pokhara, a short boat ride across Phewa Lake takes you to World Peace Pagoda (also known as Shanti Stupa), from where an amazing view of the mountains as well as a stunning panorama of Pokhara valley can be seen. The trek forward takes you through many Gurung villages allowing you to get an insight of the Gurung culture, tradition, and lifestyle. The lush green vegetation from subtropical to temperate forest all over Panchase provides shelter to a wide variety of flora and fauna.

The trek mostly goes through forests of rhododendron that come live with the constant chirping of various birds. The top of Panchase Hill provides one of the most spectacular views of sunrise and sunset over the gorgeous mountain peaks that can be seen from around Pokhara.  Panoramic view of  Annapurna South (7,219 m), Hiunchuli (6,441 m), and Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) along with an overall serene environment. This trek is perfect for those who want to connect with the locals and want to be amid nature without having to make strenuous efforts.

itinerary.title: Trek from Pokhara to Bhumdi (1,600 m / 5,249 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: The we boat cross the Fewa Lake and then climb through the forest will take you up to the steps leading to World Peace Pagoda. Being an impressive sight in itself, from this amazing point, you also get fabulous views of the Annapurna massif and Machhapuchhre (6,997 m) along with an unobstructed view of Phewa Lake and Pokhara city lying below. After a chance to wander around this truly peaceable stupa, you carry on trekking downhill through the forest on narrow walking tracks, before climbing back up to join a trail snaking around the hill, which will take you to Nehyeaal Danda. Then you will steadily ascend to Bhumdi, which is a Gurung village hosting spectacular views of Annapurna South (7,219 m) and Machhapuchhre (6,997 m). Overnight in Bhumdi.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bhumdi to Panchase Bhanjyang (2,000 m / 6,562 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: After a little climb to really wake you up, the path continues through the gorgeous forest where you can witness mountains glancing from between the trees. Today is a great day for nature lovers, as the path winds amid miscellaneous trees and you can hear the birds above; you may even catch a sight of a monkey. Emerging from the trees briefly at Thulunchaur, you then continue under the cover of the forest until the trail leads you on a dirt road. You then gradually climb uphill to reach Panchase Bhanjyang, from where you can get panoramic sights of the mountains such as Annapurna South (7,219 m), Hiunchuli (6,441 m), and Machhapuchhre (6,997 m). Similar to last night’s stop, this village is home to Gurung and Brahman people. Overnight in Panchase Bhanjyang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Panchase Bhanjyang to Panchase top (2,517 m / 8,258 ft), 3-4 hours.
itinerary.html: This early morning, you ascent the stone steps up to Panchase Peak (2,517 m), the highest point of the trek. From here, you will again be pleased with spectacular views of the mountains including the various peaks of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges, and there is also the option of getting up extra early to ascend for sunrise.

itinerary.title: Trek from Panchase top to Bhadaure and drive to Pokhara (820 m / 2,690 ft), 5-6 hours
itinerary.html: After enjoying the sunrise views , you slope down the far side of the hill to Kudbidanda. This afternoon entails of a moderate walk down the ridge with extraordinary views of the mountains above and the villages below till Bhadaure. From Bhadaure we drive to Pokhara. Overnight in Pokhara.

title: Pikey Peak Trek
summary: Pikey Peak Trek is a scenic trek in the lower part of Everest region. The trek offers spectacular panoramic views of Mt.Everest and other surrounding peaks.

seo.title: Pikey Peak Trek | 7 Days Itinerary, Guide, Cost and Map
seo.description: Pikey Peak Trek is a scenic trek in the lower part of Everest region. The trek offers spectacular panoramic views of Mt.Everest and other surrounding peaks.

overview:
Pikey Peak is situated at Lower region Everest trekking route at an altitude of 4,070 m From Pikey peak, one can get the grand view of nature; can experience the traditional livings of different ethnic groups. You can taste the verities of local cuisines and observe some rare plants and animals and as well as it is considered as the most important places of natural and biological variety. The main attraction this trek is that you can observe the best view of the highest peak of the world Mt. Everest in the short trek. From Pikey peak, one can get the grand view of mountain peaks like Dhaulagiri, Everest, Makalu, Kanchenjunga,

Ama Damlam, Lhotse, Nupatse, Numbur, Gaurisankhar, Langtang to the far west. Additionally, Pikey peak rewards tourists with one of the best sunrises and sunset views. It offers dense forests of Sunpati, Pine, Rhododendron whereas attraction of birds and animals like Lophophorus, Crimson Horned Pheasant, tiger, wild bear, Panda, Ghoral and so on. Similarly,Chauri Ghai, Nak, yak and cow can be found anywhere in this area.

You also can have pleasing view at nature's unique scenes, villages and living way of Sherpa, Tamang, Chhetri, Gurung and Sunmuwar/Rai. To reach Pikey peak, bus or jeep ride from Kathmandu to Bamtibhandar of Ramhechap district -the Okhaldhunga dhap-Khinji Phalate -Salleri of Solukhumbu district and then trek can be followed. Other alternative can be flight to Paplu airport as well.

itinerary.title: Jeep drive from Kathmandu to Dhap (2,850 m / 9,350 ft), 7-8 hours.
itinerary.html: Sharing jeep drive from Kathmandu Valley Dhap (2,850 m) is situated at the distance of 230 km. If journey will start at early 6 am, one can reach Nepal Thok for lunch. It takes around 7-8 hours of bus or jeep ride to reach Dhap.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dhap to Japrey (2,830 m / 9,285 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: After a scenic 6–7-hour drive, we reach Japrey, situated at an altitude of 2,830 m above sea level. During the spring season, particularly from mid-March to mid-May, the surrounding forests come alive with spectacular blooms of rhododendrons, creating a colorful and beautiful landscape.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jiprey to Pikey Base Camp (3,640 m / 11,942 ft), 6-7 hours
itinerary.html: Pikey Base Camp is situated at an altitude of 3,640 m above sea level, takes approximately 6–7 hours of trekking from Jiprey. Small tea houses are available along the trail, while two lodges at the base camp provide basic food and accommodation.

itinerary.title: Trek from Pikey Peak Base Camp to the summit of Pikey Peak (4,065 m / 13,337 ft), then descend to Jasmane Bhanjyang (3,550 m / 11,647 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: We wake up early in the morning, dress warmly, and begin our ascent to Pikey Peak (4,065 m). It takes approximately one hour of walking to reach the summit. From the top, enjoy a spectacular sunrise and breathtaking panoramic views of the Himalayas, including Mount Everest, Makalu, Kanchenjunga, Ama Dablam, Cho Oyu, Lhotse, Nuptse, Numbur Himal, Gaurishankar, and many other magnificent peaks. After enjoying the sunrise and Himalayan panorama, we descend to Jasmane Bhanjyang, where we spend the night.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jasmane Bhanjyang to Junbesi (2,700 m / 8,858 ft), 6-7 hours.
itinerary.html: Today breakfast we start trek towards Junbesi. We can be reached Taktor for Lunch after 2/3 hours. After taking lunch we contineue our trek to Junbesi. Junbesi is considered to be Sherpa's most beautiful villages, which lies at the height of 2,990 m above sea level. There is an ancient Budhist Monestry. overnight at a lodge in Junbesi.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jenbesi to Phaplu (2,413 m / 7,917 ft), 5-6 hours.
itinerary.html: The trail from Junbesi to Phaplu (aprox 13-14 km) is a scenic and relatively easy. The route passes through beautiful villages and forests. It is gradually descends toward Phaplu, passing small settlements and terraced fields along the way. As you approach Phaplu bazar, the landscape becomes more open, with views of the surrounding hills and valleys.

itinerary.title: Drive from Phaplu to Kathmandu by a local sharing jeep, 8-9 hours.
itinerary.html: Early morning, take a local shared jeep from Phaplu to Kathmandu. The drive takes approximately 8–9 hours through scenic mountain roads.

title: Pisang Peak Climbing
summary: The Pisang Peak Climbing rises above from Pisang village and alpine yak pastures in a uniform slope of ice and snow to the snow capped summit.

seo.title: Pisang Peak Climbing, Cost, Itinerary, Map - Base Camp Adventure
seo.description: The Pisang Peak Climbing rises above from Pisang village and alpine yak pastures in a uniform slope of ice and snow to the snow capped summit.

overview:
The Pisang Peak Climbing rises above from Pisang village and alpine yak pastures in a uniform slope of ice and snow to the snow capped summit.

After the summit we follow the trail to classic Thorung La pass, descend down to the ever popular Muktinath temple and further to Birethanti and complete the trip. Those with shorter holiday can take a flight from Jomsom to Pokhara omitting the last part of the trek.

The climbing group will be accompanied by a climbing guide, base camp support guide, camp cook , and necessary number of porters. You just carry your day pack, rest is carried by our porters and the usual walking hour is 6 hours. Back at kathmandu we celebrate your amazing trip with tradiitional Nepali dinner and ethnic cultural show.

title: Punakha Domoche Trekking
summary: The highlight of  is Punakha Domoche Trekking is  the Punakha festival consisting of typical masked dances. Punakha Dromchoe is a eight days long festival.

seo.title: Punakha Domoche Trekking | Unique Punakha Festival Tour
seo.description: The highlight of  is Punakha Domoche Trekking is  the Punakha festival consisting of typical masked dances. Punakha Dromchoe is a eight days long festival.

overview:
The highlight of  is Punakha Domoche Trekking is  the Punakha festival consisting of typical masked dances which are very colourful and interesting, the events and enactments are different on each day. Punakha Dromchoe is a eight days long festival dedicated to the goddess Mahakala. The religious aspects are performed in the same manner as in early times. On the last day, a play of warriors going off to war is enacted.

The contrast between the climate and vegetation in Punakha at 1,800 m and Thimphu and Paro valleys at 2,400 m will be clearly felt as you spend a few days in Paro at the beginning of your trip and a few days in the capital city, Thimphu, at the end of the tour. In Paro you will visit the dzong, the museum, temples and farmhouses. The excursion to Taktsang Monastry is well worth the effort it is classed as Paro’s most famous and most deeply revered religious site. In Thimphu, you will spend a full day of sightseeing.
